facility.HQ.sommario: Obukulembeze, akakiiko k'abasayansi n'okugatta omukutu gwonna.
facility.HQ.descrizione: Obukulembeze Obukulu bwe bugatta omukutu gw'ensi yonna, akakiiko k'abasayansi n'enkolagana n'abasasuli. Wano we basalirawo ebikulembezza, ssente n'engendo ya Programma Sigma. Bwetaaga ebivaamu, era babyetaaga mangu.
facility.N1.sommario: Etterekero ery'omu bunnyogovu (cryobank) n'ennyingo y'obuzaale (genomic archive) omukutu gwonna gwe guva.
facility.N1.descrizione: Kino kye kifo ekyasooka mu byafaayo bya Eden Exotic, kikuuma ensibuko z'obuzaale, ebibutuka (embryos) ebiterekeddwa mu bunnyogovu n'etterekero ly'obuzaale erya buli mulembe. Wano we lyazaalirwa, ng'ekyokugezesa (proof-of-concept), Omulembe 1 ogwa Protocollo A. Tewali kirundwa kiramu wano: ekiterekebwa gwe mukisa gw'okuddamu okutandika byonna okuva ku ntandikwa. Abakozi bakiyita «omulandira» kubanga tewali kifo kiyinza kubaawo awatali ekiterekeddwa wano.
facility.N1.specie: Ensibuko z'obuzaale, ebibutuka n'ebitundu by'omubiri eby'ebika byonna ebiterekeddwa mu bunnyogovu
facility.N2.sommario: Okulaba okusaasaanye n'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu (biomaterials) eby'obwoya bwa nnabbubi eby'omutindo ogwa waggulu.
facility.N2.descrizione: Nga kiri wakati mu kibira ekyetoolodde Iquitos, ekifo kino kinoonyereza ku kulaba okw'ekitalo n'obusobozi bw'okugonjoola ebizibu obwa nnabbubi abasala (jumping spiders), awamu n'amaanyi ga ttalantula. Waliwo ennoonyereza ebbiri enkulu: okulaba okusaasaanye — sensa nnyingi ez'enjawulo ez'amaaso ezizzaawo ekifaananyi kimu eky'obutonde — n'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu ebiva mu bwoya bwa nnabbubi, nga bikozesebwa mu ngoye za tekinologiya n'ebyuma by'obujjanjabi (biomedical devices). Kino kifo ky'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu ebitaleeta buzibu ku butonde era kikola nga kikolagana n'abantu b'ekitundu.
facility.N3.sommario: Okuzzaawo ekifiiridde: okuzzaawo ebitundu by'omubiri n'amagulu.
facility.N3.descrizione: Mu mbeera y'obunnyogovu obungi obwa Hokkaidō kirunda amphibians (ebisolo eby'omu mazzi n'oku lukalu) asobola okuzzaawo amagulu n'ebitundu by'omubiri, nga axolotl ye kika ekikulu. Ekigendererwa ky'ekifo kino kwe kuvvuunula obusobozi buno mu bujjanjabi obuzzaawo ebitundu (regenerative medicine) mu bantu, nga bukozesebwa obuzaale obw'okuzzaawo obusangibwa mu amphibians ne mu bisolo ebiyonsa. Ebibinja bino binafu era byetaaga okulabirirwa okutuufu ennyo, abakozi kwe bawa omutindo gw'obulamu bw'ensolo ogwa waggulu ennyo mu mukutu.
facility.N4.descrizione: Kifo ekitalimu bulwadde era eky'ensengeka enkalu, ekyakolebwa okusobola okufuga obulungi embeera z'okugezesa. Kikola pulogulaamu ey'amagezi n'enneeyisa ya iguana, nga waliwo ebigezo ebya bulijjo eby'okuyiga, okujjukira n'okugonjoola ebizibu. Mu nsolo ezigobererwa mu kunoonyereza kw'enneeyisa mwe muli 47B (4-07-B-ATC), eyateekebwa mu Protocollo B. Wano we kikolera ekibinja kya Marco Conti n'omukuguuse mu nneeyisa Dominika Gradowska.
facility.N5.sommario: Obutabaganya bw'obusagwa olw'eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa n'obujjanjabi, nga waliwo n'ekitundu eky'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) ekyeekeneenyezebwa.
facility.N5.descrizione: Ku nkuba y'e Ghati Occidentali kirunda emisota olw'okugabanyaamu obusagwa bwagyo n'okumanya obutwa bwagyo. Molekyu ezaawulibwa zifuuka ebiyinza okukola eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa, eriziyiza obulumi n'eriziyiza omusaayi okukwata: kuno kunoonyereza kw'eddagala n'eby'eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa, okukolerwa mu nsi awabeera abantu enkumi n'enkumi bafa buli mwaka olw'okulumwa emisota. Ekitundu ekimu eky'okunoonyereza kirina enkozesa ebbiri era kifugibwa n'okulabirira okw'enjawulo, nga eddagala ery'obujjanjabi likolerwa mu Buyindi n'emirimu egikwata ku by'okwerinda gikwataganyizibwa n'Ekifo N.10.
facility.N5.specie: Emisota (elapidi ne viperidi ez'e Ghati Occidentali)
facility.N6.sommario: Enswaswa (varani) ezaakolebwako obuzaale olw'amaanyi, obugumu n'okukola mu mbeera enkambwe.
facility.N6.descrizione: Ku bitosi bya Pripyat kirunda enswaswa (varani) ezongezeddwa amaanyi — ennene, ez'embiro, ez'amaanyi era ezisobola okutendekebwa emirimu egikwataganya — mu pulogulaamu eyeekuusa ku maanyi g'omubiri, obugumu n'okukola mu mbeera enkambwe. Wansi w'obukulembeze bwa Col. Zaremba, ekibinja ky'ensolo (94G «Smok», 91F «Cień», 88G «Żubr» n'endala) kinoonyerezebwako olw'okukozesebwa mu Programma Sigma, olunyiriri lw'okunoonyereza olw'okwerinda olwa Eden Exotic, mu nkola z'okukakasa ezitegekeddwa.
facility.N7.tema: Ekkubo — okutereeza omunnyo, okulaga ekkubo, obuwangaazi
facility.N7.sommario: Omunnyo, magineeti n'obulamu obuwangaazi: okuwona n'okwemanyiisa mu nnyanja.
facility.N7.descrizione: Wakati wa Sulawesi n'Ennyanja ya Banda kirunda ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja n'enfudu okusobola okusoma engeri gye zitereeza omunnyo, engeri gye zeekubira amabanga amawanvu n'obuwangaazi obw'ekitalo. Ebisenge by'omunnyo, okuwulira magineeti n'obuwangaazi bw'obutoffaali (telomeres) bino bye biwaka bisatu eby'okunoonyereza, nga bikozesebwa mu kwetereeza kw'omuntu ku bbula ly'amazzi n'embeera enkambwe. Kikolera kumpi ne Bayobanka N.1 ku nsibuko ez'obuwangaazi.
facility.N8.sommario: Ekiwanika ekiramu: okukyusa langi mangu, wakati w'okunoonyereza n'okukuuma.
facility.N8.descrizione: Ku lubalama lw'Ennyanja Nnalubaale kigatta obulunzi ne sitensoni ey'oku ttale okusoma nnankinsooki (chameleons) n'engeri gye zikyusaamu langi mangu, nga kabonero era ng'okwekweka. Ekifo kino kikola pulogulaamu bbiri ezigattagana: pulunjekiti emanyiddwa ey'okukuuma ebitundu ebifunda, nga muliwo okuzza n'okulondoola ebibinja by'ekitundu, n'okunoonyereza okukozesebwa ku butoffaali obukyusa langi (chromatophores) olw'okukola engulu ezikyusa langi. Kye kifo kyokka mu mukutu ekigatta obulunzi n'omulimu ogw'oku ttale.
facility.N9.sommario: Ekifo ekibalirira eky'omukutu: okukola enkola z'obuzaale n'pulogulaamu ey'okwetereeza mu bunnyogovu.
facility.N9.descrizione: Mu Kiruna, waggulu w'Ekipimo eky'Amaserengeta, kye kifo ekibalirira ekya Eden Exotic: data center enyogezebwa embeera y'omu bukiikakkono (Arctic) ekola enkola ey'omukutu gwonna ogw'obuzaale. Kiragula ebiva mu kukyusa obuzaale, kinoonya mu nnyiriri z'obuzaale obubonero bw'engeri empya era kikola pulogulaamu ey'okwetereeza mu bunnyogovu. Tekirimu nsolo nnamu: kirongoosa data z'obuzaale n'enkola z'okubalirira zokka ez'okuyamba ebifo ebirala.
facility.N9.specie: Tewali kika kiramu; data z'obuzaale n'enkola z'okubalirira
facility.N10.sommario: Ekifo eky'okukakasa, okugatta mu nkola n'okwerinda okwa Programma Sigma.
facility.N10.descrizione: Mu kifo ekikuumibwa mu Amerika, kye kifo eky'okukakasa, okugatta mu nkola n'okwerinda okwa Programma Sigma. Wano ensolo ne tekinologiya ebikolerwa mu bifo ebirala biteekebwa mu kukakasa okw'enkozesa nga bwe zigobererwa enkola z'okwerinda. Programma Sigma lwe lunyiriri lw'okunoonyereza olw'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) olwa Eden Exotic, nga lulina ebigendererwa ebilangiddwa eby'okwerinda, okukola mu mbeera enkambwe n'obuyambi, nga lukolerwa nga bwe kigobererwa enkola y'obuvunaanyizibwa ekozesebwa ekkampuni.
facility.N10.specie: Tewali kika kyakyo; kigatta era kikakasa ensolo eziva mu bifo ebirala
facility.N11.sommario: Pulogulaamu ey'amagezi g'ennyonyi n'ebivuga (bioacustica): okwefaananyiriza amaloboozi n'okukozesa ebikozesebwa.
facility.N11.descrizione: Mu New Caledonia, ekitundu ekya namuŋŋoona akozesa ebikozesebwa, kye kitundu ky'ennyonyi ekikyakolebwa: enkusu olw'okusoma okwefaananyiriza amaloboozi n'okuvuga eddoboozi; namuŋŋoona olw'okukozesa ebikozesebwa, okugonjoola ebizibu n'enneeyisa y'ekibinja. Pulogulaamu egatta bioacustica n'okwekenneenya amagezi, ng'ekigendererwa kiri kwe kutegeera engeri okuwuliziganya kw'amaloboozi n'obwenkanya obw'omu kibinja bwe bikolamu mu nnyonyi.
facility.N11.specie: Ennyonyi: namuŋŋoona (namuŋŋoona za New Caledonia) n'enkusu
facility.N12.sommario: Ekifo ky'obulunzi ekipya ekikyazimbibwa ekyeekuusa ku byewalula ebyetegese mu bifo eby'ekyeeya ekingi.
facility.N12.descrizione: Okuzimba Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.12 kigenda mu maaso mu Ddungu lya Namib. Ekifo kijja kunoonyereza ku kutereeza omunnyo n'okugumira okukala mu mbeera y'ekyeeya ekingi. Ebizimbe byakolebwa okuzza mu ngeri efugibwa embeera z'ebbugumu n'obunnyogovu ez'omu ddungu. Okuggulawo kusuubirwa nga emirimu n'okukakasa okw'obulamu biwedde.
facility.N13.tema: Olusozi — amasannyalaze ga UV n'okunyigirizibwa okungi
facility.N13.sommario: Ekifo ky'okunoonyereza ekiteekeddwateekeddwa olw'okusoma embeera z'ewaggulu ennyo ez'amasannyalaze amangi.
facility.N13.descrizione: Ekifo N.13 pulojekiti ekakasibwa, nga kisuubirwa okuggulawo mu biseera eby'omu maaso. Ekifo kijja kwekuusa ku bikwata ku bugulumivu obungi, amasannyalaze amangi aga UV n'enkyukakyuka y'ebbugumu enkambwe. Tekijja kubaamu bika biramu naye kijja kukola okupima kw'obutonde n'okugezesa mu laabu ku byokulabirako n'ebikozesebwa. Ddungu lya Atacama lyalondebwa olw'embeera zaalyo enkambwe era enywevu.
facility.N13.specie: Tewali kika kiramu; sitensoni y'okunoonyereza ku mbeera enkambwe
facility.N15.sommario: Ekifo eky'oku lubalama eky'edda ekiri mu kuggalwawo n'okugatta emirimu.
facility.N15.descrizione: Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.15 kiri mu kuggalwawo. Emirimu n'ennyiriri z'ennyanja ez'edda ziri mu kugattibwa ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.7 mu Indoneziya. Okuwaayo kukolebwa mpolampola, nga olunyiriri lw'okukuuma n'omutindo gw'obulamu bikuumibwa. Enkola bw'eneemala, ekifo kijja kulekera awo emirimu gy'obulunzi.
facility.N16.sommario: Ekifo eky'okubiri ekya Programma Sigma, ekyeekuusa ku kukakasa n'okugezesa mu nkola, mu kifo ekitayolesebwa.
facility.N16.descrizione: Ekifo N.16 kye kifo eky'okubiri ekya Programma Sigma, nga kiri mu kifo ekitayolesebwa. Kikola ku kukakasa n'okugatta ebivaamu, nga kikolagana n'Ekifo N.10. Tekirina bika byakyo era kikola okusinga ku kugezesa oku ttale n'okukakasa mu nkola. Ebipimo ebiwaayo bya kumpiwa olw'ensonga z'okukuuma ebyama.
facility.N16.specie: Tewali kika kyakyo; okukakasa n'okugezesa oku ttale
facility.LOG.tema: Okuyita — okwewala endwadde n'okutambuza mu CITES
facility.LOG.sommario: Ekifo ky'ebyentambula olw'okusengula, okwewala endwadde n'okuddukanya olunyiriri lw'okukuuma olwa CITES.
facility.LOG.descrizione: Ekifo ky'Ebyentambula n'Okwewala Endwadde kikola ng'ekifo ekigatta okusengula wakati w'ebifo by'omukutu. Kiddukanya okwewala endwadde n'olunyiriri lw'okukuuma olwa CITES olw'okutambuza mu nsi yonna. Okubeera ku mwalo gwa Rotterdam kisobozesa enkolagana ennungi eri ebifo bya Bulaaya n'ebweru wa Bulaaya. Ekizimbe tekirunda bika era tekirabika ku maapu y'ebifo ebikola.
facility.REGAMER.sommario: Ofiisi eyeekuusa ku mateeka, obwannannyini bw'ebirowoozo n'enkolagana mu Amerika.
facility.REGAMER.descrizione: Ofiisi y'Emirimu gy'Amateeka olwa Amerika efaayo ku nkolagana n'abakulira ab'ekitundu. Egoberera obwannannyini bw'ebirowoozo, ebikwata ku mateeka n'enkolagana n'ebitongole n'eby'obusuubuzi. Okubeera mu Boston kisobozesa okubeera kumpi n'ebifo ebikulu eby'ebya tekinologiya ey'obulamu mu bukiikakkono bwa Amerika. Ekizimbe kikola emirimu egy'obulambuzi era tekirimu bika.
facility.REGAPAC.sommario: Ofiisi y'ekitundu ey'okukwataganya, okugoberera amateeka n'enkolagana n'ebitongole mu kitundu kya Asia-Pacific.
facility.REGAPAC.descrizione: Ofiisi y'Ekitundu ekya Asia-Pacific ekwataganya emirimu gy'omukutu mu kitundu kya APAC. Egoberera okugoberera amateeka n'enkolagana n'ebitongole eby'ekitundu. Okubeera mu Singapore kiwa ekifo eky'omu makkati eri ebifo bya Asia n'oku nnyanja. Ekizimbe kikola emirimu egy'okukwataganya era tekirunda bika.
facility.BIOPROD.tema: Ebivaamu — okuva mu kunoonyereza okutuuka ku bunene
facility.BIOPROD.sommario: Ekyuma ky'okugezesa ekikyazimbibwa olw'okwongera obunene bw'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu n'ebintu ebiva mu kunoonyereza.
facility.BIOPROD.descrizione: Ekyuma ky'Okugezesa eky'Okukola Ebintu eby'Obulamu kikyazimbibwa mu Cork. Kijja kwekuusa ku kwongera obunene bw'obwoya bwa nnabbubi, peptides n'ebintu ebiva mu kunoonyereza. Ekyuma tekijja kubaamu bika biramu era kijja kukola ku nkola z'okukola ezifugibwa. Ekigendererwa kwe kuvvuunula ebivaamu mu laabu okubifuula ebunene obw'okugezesa.
facility.BIOPROD.specie: Tewali kika kiramu; okwongera obunene bw'ebikozesebwa n'ebintu
facility.ARCH.sommario: Ekikoppi eky'okwekuuma eky'omu bunnyogovu eky'ensibuko z'obuzaale ne data z'obuzaale, mu mbeera y'omu bukiikakkono.
facility.ARCH.descrizione: Etterekero ery'Okwerondako n'Okuzzaawo Data likuuma ekikoppi eky'okwekuuma eky'omu bunnyogovu ekya Bayobanka N.1 n'etterekero ly'obuzaale. Okubeera mu bukiikakkono e Svalbard kiwa embeera enywevu ez'ebbugumu eppa n'okwerondako mu bifo eby'enjawulo. Ekizimbe kikuuma ebintu eby'ensibuko z'obuzaale ne data, awatali kubeeramu bika biramu. Enkola z'okuzzaawo data zikakasa nti etterekero terikoma ne bwe wandibaddewo okufiirwa mu kifo ekisooka.
facility.ARCH.specie: Ekikoppi ky'ensibuko z'obuzaale ne data z'obuzaale
facility.FIELD.sommario: Sitensoni ey'oku ttale olw'omulimu mu Amazzonia n'okukuŋŋaanya ensibuko ez'omu nsiko.
facility.FIELD.descrizione: Sitensoni ey'oku Ttale eya Amazzonia ekola omulimu oku ttale n'okukuŋŋaanya ennyiriri ez'omu nsiko eza bulijjo ez'okwesigamako. Ekolagana n'Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.2 n'Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.7 mu kugabana ebyokulabirako ne data z'obwaddundi bw'ebiramu. Okubeera mu Manaus kiwa okuyingira mu bbugwe lya Amazzoni. Ekizimbe tekirunda bika naye kikola ng'ekifo eky'emirimu egy'oku ttale.
facility.FIELD.specie: Okusoma n'okukuŋŋaanya ennyiriri ez'omu nsiko ez'okwesigamako
facility.ZERO.sommario: Laabu esooka ey'ekkampuni ey'edda, kaakati eyaggalwawo.
facility.ZERO.descrizione: Ekifo Zero kye kyali laabu esooka ey'okugezesa ey'ekkampuni. Kyaggalwawo oluvannyuma lwa Omulembe 1 era ebintu byakyo byaweebwayo Bayobanka N.1. Ennyiriri ezaasooka ezaakolebwa wano kaakati ziterekeddwa era zikuumibwa mu mukutu. Ekifo tekikyakola era kirina omuwendo gw'ebyafaayo gwokka.
facility.EXMARINE.sommario: Sitensoni ey'oku lubalama ey'okugezesa ey'edda, eyaggalwawo n'egattibwa mu pulogulaamu z'ennyanja ez'omukutu.
facility.EXMARINE.descrizione: Sitensoni y'Ennyanja ey'Edda yali sitensoni ey'oku lubalama ey'okugezesa eyeekuusa ku kunoonyereza okwasooka ku byewalula eby'omu nnyanja. Yaggalwawo era emirimu gyayo gyagattibwa mu pulogulaamu z'ennyanja ez'omukutu. Okubeera mu Peniche kwakola omulimu ogw'okugezesa mu biseera ebyasooka eby'omulimu ogw'oku lubalama. Ekizimbe tekikyakola.
facility.EXMARINE.specie: Eby'edda: okunoonyereza okwasooka ku byewalula eby'omu nnyanja
facility.VILLA.sommario: Ekifo eky'obwannannyini era ekikuumibwa olw'okusoma enneeyisa okwa kumpi.
facility.VILLA.descrizione: Ekizimbe ekiyamba Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.4: eyumba erina ebisenge eby'obuntu waggulu ne laabu ey'omulembe wansi. Ekifo eky'obwannannyini era ekikuumibwa, ekyayagalibwa Obukulembeze okusoma okumpi ensolo ezisinga okusanyusa nga ziri wala ne laabu enkulu.
person.stern.bio: Nga Omukulu Asinga Obuvunaanyizibwa owa Eden Exotic, Maria Stern y'atudde ku ntikko ya HQ era akwataganya omukutu gwonna ogw'ebifo ebiriko ennamba, okuva ku laabu z'ensibuko z'obuzaale eza N.1 okutuuka ku bifo bya Sigma ebya N.10. Alabirira enfuga y'ekkampuni, engeri y'okunoonyereza kw'abasayansi n'okugaba eby'obugagga, ng'atereeza wakati w'ebikulembezza eby'okunoonyereza n'ebyetaagisa eby'okwerinda n'okugoberera amateeka. Akkiriza ssente, asalawo pulogulaamu ki ez'okwanguyiza era ateekawo omutindo gw'obuvunaanyizibwa n'obwannamawulire bw'ekkampuni.
person.stern.voce: Ayogera n'obukkakkamu obupimibwa n'ebigambo ebimpi, aliko obuyinza awatali kuyimusa ddoboozi, era alonda buli kigambo n'obwegendereza.
person.stern.background: Yasoma eby'obusawo n'okuddukanya eby'obusayansi, yayambuka ng'ayita mu kunoonyereza okuvvuunula (translational research) n'okuddukanya pulogulaamu ennene eza tekinologiya ey'obulamu nga tannaba kukwata bukulembeze bwa Eden Exotic.
person.conti.bio: Nga y'omukulira Protocollo B ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Marco Conti akulembera okunoonyereza ku nkula y'obwongo n'obubonero bw'enneeyisa y'ensolo. Buli lunaku akola enteekateeka z'okugezesa, akwekenneenya obubonero bw'obwongo era akwataganya ekibinja mu kutegeera data z'enneeyisa n'amagezi g'ensolo. Omulimu gwe gwekuusa ku kuzuula embeera z'obulamu ezikwatagana n'enkula y'amagezi, nga zisomebwa n'enkola y'obusayansi entuufu.
person.conti.voce: Ajjudde essanyu era wa mangu, ava ku ndowooza emu adda ku ndala n'obunyiikivu, naye buli kiseera adda ku data ez'okugezesa.
person.conti.background: Alina digiri ya PhD mu neurobiology n'emyaka egy'okunoonyereza ku bukyukakyusa bw'obwongo, yajja mu Eden Exotic okusoma amagezi g'ensolo n'ebikozesebwa eby'okugezesa eby'omulembe.
person.marini.bio: Nga y'omukugu w'obuzaale owa Pulogulaamu ya Iguana ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Elena Marini akola era akakasa ennyiriri z'okukyusa obuzaale era akebera data z'okulaga obuzaale. Aleeta ekibinja ky'okunoonyereza ku bwegendereza obupima, ng'akebera yekka ebifaananyi nga tannabikakasa. Asiimibwa olw'obwenkanya n'okufaayo ku mutindo gwa data.
person.marini.voce: Wa mazima era ogw'obutereevu, azza emboozi ku data n'ebibuuzo ebituufu, wa mukwano naye wa mugaso.
person.marini.background: Yasoma obuzaale mu kitongole ky'okunoonyereza eky'obuwanguzi, yakyuka n'agenda mu bwannannyini okukola ku pulogulaamu z'okukyusa obuzaale ez'ekigero ekinene.
person.bianchi.ruolo: Omukugu wa Biology y'obutoffaali · Pulogulaamu ya Iguana
person.bianchi.bio: Nga y'omukugu wa biology y'obutoffaali owa Pulogulaamu ya Iguana ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Paolo Bianchi anokola ebizimbe by'obuzaale era alondoola ebibonerezo ebitali ku kifo ekigenderere (off-target). Afaayo ku kukuuma obukuumi bw'obulamu n'okwekenneenya obulabe obw'obulamu, ng'awagira enkola ey'obwegendereza mu kukola okugezesa. Ye ddoboozi eriwabula ekibinja okukakasa ebivaamu nga tebannaba kugenda mu maaso.
person.bianchi.voce: Wa mukkakkamu era alowooza, ateeka ebirowoozo bye ng'ebibuuzo era ayita ekibinja mu bwegendereza obw'enkola.
person.bianchi.background: Yatambula ekiseera ekiwanvu mu biology y'obutoffaali wakati wa yunivasite n'ebifo by'okunoonyereza, yeegatta ku Eden Exotic okuyamba ku bukuumi n'obwegendereza obwa pulogulaamu.
person.colombo.ruolo: Omuyizi wa PhD · Pulogulaamu ya Iguana
person.colombo.bio: Nga y'omuyizi wa PhD era asinga obuto mu kibinja ky'okunoonyereza ekya Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Alessandro Colombo ayamba abanoonyereza mu mirimu gya laabu: okutegeka ebyokulabirako, okulongoosa data n'okuddukanya ebiwandiiko by'okugezesa. Aleeta amaanyi n'obusobozi bw'okugatta data mu ngeri empya. Wa ssuubi era anywereza obumanyirivu bwe mu kibinja.
person.colombo.voce: Wa mangu era ajjudde essanyu, wa mukwano, ayaka ng'agoberera endowooza empya.
person.colombo.background: Omuyizi wa PhD mu byobulamu, yayingira Pulogulaamu ya Iguana ng'omunoonyereza omuto eyasikirizibwa okunoonyereza okw'omu maaso.
person.puddu.ruolo: Omukozi wa Laabu · Pulogulaamu ya Iguana
person.puddu.bio: Nga y'omukozi wa laabu owa Pulogulaamu ya Iguana ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Marina Puddu agoberera ensolo buli lunaku: emmere, obuyonjo bw'ebifo, okulondoola ebipimo n'okwetegereza. Obumanyirivu bwe obungi n'okubeera kumpi n'ensolo bimufuula omwegendereza ennyo mu kuwandiika enneeyisa n'okulaga amangu buli nkyukakyuka eri abanoonyereza. Ye muntu ow'okwesigama ku ku kulabirira ensolo.
person.puddu.voce: Wa bwangu era ow'ekisa, wa mazima mu kunnyonnyola ensolo era afaayo ku bikwata ku nneeyisa yaazo.
person.puddu.background: Yasoma eby'obukugu mu byobulamu bw'ensolo n'emyaka egy'obumanyirivu mu bifo by'okulunda, y'ajjukira emirimu egya bulijjo egya pulogulaamu.
person.dominika.bio: Nga y'omukugu w'enneeyisa owa Pulogulaamu ya Iguana era omunoonyereza ali mu Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.4, Dominika Gradowska akola enkola z'okwetegereza, awandiika ennyiriri z'enneeyisa era azimba enkola z'okubalirira okuzuula ebifaananyi mu data z'ensolo. Alina okujjukira okulungi n'obusobozi obw'amaanyi obw'okuzuula ebifaananyi, era ayamba mu kwekenneenya enneeyisa y'ekibinja. Muzzukulu wa Poland, akuuma ebiwandiiko ebituufu era ebijjuvu.
person.dominika.voce: Wa butuufu era wa maanyi, aliko akalulu akatono aka Poland, akyusaakyusa wakati w'ebigambo ebimpi n'okunnyonnyola okujjudde ebikwata.
person.dominika.background: Yasoma ethology n'esayansi z'amagezi mu Poland, yayingira Eden Exotic okukozesa obusobozi bwe obw'okwekenneenya mu kusoma enneeyisa y'ensolo.
person.monti.bio: Nga y'Omukulu w'Obusayansi era omukugu wa ethology owa Villa Monti, pulofeesa Alfredo Monti akulembera okunoonyereza kw'ekifo era y'akiiraga mu by'obuyivu. Asoma enneeyisa n'amagezi g'ensolo n'enkola ya ethology era ye muntu ow'okwesigama mu by'obusayansi eri pulogulaamu ya Varani, ate era y'ayogeza n'obukulembeze bw'ekkampuni. Amanyiddwa olw'okufaayo ku bulamu bw'ensolo n'obwegendereza obw'enkola.
person.monti.voce: Wa magezi era mugumiikiriza, ayogera n'obukkakkamu obw'omuyigiriza era ayongera mu bigambo bye ebibuuzo ebisikiriza okulowooza.
person.monti.background: Omuyivu ow'emyaka mingi mu ethology, aleeta mu Eden Exotic obumanyirivu bwe obw'obusayansi olw'okusoma okumpi enneeyisa y'ensolo.
person.adele.bio: Nga y'omukulira Okwerinda n'Okugoberera Amateeka owa Villa Monti, Adele Ricci addukanya okuyingira, enkola z'obwama n'okukuuma amawulire n'obwegendereza obungi. Ye akwataganya ekifo ne Programma Sigma, ng'akakasa nti okugaba amawulire kukolebwa nga bwe kigobererwa enkola n'omutindo gw'okugoberera. Omulimu gwe gukakasa okuddukanya okutuufu era okuvunaanyizibwa okw'amawulire amazibu.
person.adele.voce: Wa mugaso era yeefuga, awa ebiragiro n'okunnyonnyola mu bigambo ebimpi era ebituufu.
person.adele.background: Ava mu kkubo ery'okwerinda n'okugoberera amateeka ery'enkola enkalu, era y'akuuma enkolagana wakati wa Villa ne Programma Sigma.
person.pietro.ruolo: Omuyizi wa PhD · Laabu ya Villa Monti
person.pietro.bio: Pietro Visconti yali muyizi wa PhD ku Laabu ya Villa Monti, omunoonyereza omugezi mu ndowooza n'okuteekateeka okw'okugezesa. Yakola ku biology y'okugezesa n'okusoma amagezi g'ensolo, n'enkola erina ekigendererwa ekinene. Yava mu laabu oluvannyuma lw'akabenje akaali mu mulimu ogw'okugezesa.
person.pietro.voce: Yali ajjudde essanyu era yeesiga, yayogeranga ku mulimu gwe n'obunyiikivu n'okwegomba.
person.pietro.background: Omunoonyereza omuto era omuyivu eyali ku PhD ku Villa Monti, yagatta okusoma okunywevu okw'endowooza n'omwoyo ogw'amaanyi ogw'okugezesa.
person.giancarlo.bio: Giancarlo ye muyambi ow'edda ow'Obukulembeze bw'Obusayansi owa Villa Monti. Addukanya enteekateeka za pulofeesa Monti, ategeka ebintu n'enkuŋŋaana era akuuma amaterekero n'ebbaluwa, ng'amanyi bulungi ensengeka y'ekifo. Ye muntu ow'obuteesa era ow'okwesigwa, ow'okwesigama ku mirimu egya bulijjo egya Villa.
person.giancarlo.voce: Wa mpisa era mugaso, addamu n'ebigambo ebitono era n'obuteesa.
person.giancarlo.background: Okumala ekiseera ekiwanvu ng'ali ku ludda lwa pulofeesa Monti, yazimba ekifo kye ku kugenda mu maaso n'obwesige okusinga ku bulambuzi.
person.zaremba.bio: Kanoni Stefan Zaremba y'aduumira Laabu N.6, pulogulaamu ya Varani we ekolera n'omutindo gw'okulagirira okw'amagye. Akwataganya ebibinja n'abagoberezi, apima obulabe obw'omu mirimu era akakasa enkolagana wakati w'ebyetaagisa eby'obusayansi n'olunyiriri lw'obuduumizi. Amanyiddwa olw'obwegendereza, obwesimbu n'okufaayo ku kwerinda oku ttale.
person.zaremba.voce: Wa maanyi era wa mpisa, awa ebiragiro ebitegeerekeka awatali bigambo bya bwereere, n'obwegendereza obufuuka ng'empisa.
person.zaremba.background: Omuduumizi ow'emyaka mingi eyaliko obwesimbu obw'ekitalo, yateekebwa okuduumira Laabu N.6 okukakasa entegeka n'obwesige eri pulogulaamu ya Varani.
person.nowak.bio: Nga y'omusawo w'ensolo owa pulogulaamu ya Varani ku Laabu N.6, Wiktor Nowak afaayo ku bulamu n'obulungi bw'ensolo: okukebera obulamu, emmere, okuddukanya okunyigirizibwa n'okwekenneenya obusobozi obw'okukola emirimu. Akolagana n'abagoberezi okukuuma ensolo mu mbeera ennungi era afaayo ku bulamu bw'ensolo. Asiimibwa olw'obukugu obw'obusawo n'okufaayo okw'omulimu.
person.nowak.voce: Wa kisa era yeekomako, wa butuufu era wa bukugu bw'obusawo ng'ayogera ku bulamu bw'ensolo.
person.nowak.background: Omusawo w'ensolo eyasoma ku bulamu bw'ensolo ennene, yalondebwa mu pulogulaamu ya Varani olw'obukugu bwe ku byewalula.
person.gorski.bio: Nga y'ofisa omutono era Handler-Alpha ow'Ekibinja kya Varani ku Laabu N.6, Tomek Górski ye mugoberezi omukulu ow'ekibinja ky'ensolo. Yaliko omugoberezi w'embwa, akozesa enkola esinziira ku nkolagana ezimbibwa mu kiseera: okubeerawo n'obukkakkamu, obubonero obw'olutata n'obwesige obufunibwa buli lunaku. Akulembera okutendeka, apima embeera y'ekibinja era avvuunula ebyetaagisa eby'omirimu okubifuula obulagirizi obutegeerekeka eri ensolo.
person.gorski.voce: Wa bbugumu era ow'obutereevu, ayogera ku nsolo n'okwagala okukalu okw'omulwanyi omukadde, mu ddoboozi eppa era eriwummuza.
person.gorski.background: Yaliko omugoberezi w'embwa mu magye, yaleeta mu pulogulaamu ya Varani enkola esinziira ku nkolagana, n'afuuka Handler-Alpha omusooka ow'ekibinja.
person.sokol.bio: Nga y'ofisa (sergeant) era Handler-Asikira ow'Ekibinja kya Varani ku Laabu N.6, Rafał Sokół ayamba Górski mu kuduumira ekibinja era assuubirwa okumusikira nga Alpha. Yaliko omugoberezi w'embwa, yeetendekeza n'ensolo era akozesa enkola z'enkolagana ez'ekibinja, ng'azimba mpolampola obwesige n'ekibinja. Asiimibwa olw'obunyiikivu n'obusobozi obw'okwenkanya mu mirimu.
person.sokol.voce: Yeekomako era wa mugaso, ayogera katono ku ye yennyini naye nnyo ku mulimu, n'obumazima.
person.sokol.background: Yaliko omugoberezi w'embwa, yateekebwa mu pulogulaamu ya Varani nga handler-asikira okwetegekera omulimu gwa Alpha ow'ekibinja.
person.ursula-brunner.ruolo: Omukulira Bayobanka era omukuumi w'etterekero ly'obuzaale
person.ursula-brunner.bio: Nga y'omukulira Bayobanka ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1, Ursula Brunner yamaze emyaka amakumi abiri ng'azimba enkalala y'ensibuko z'obuzaale eza Eden Exotic. Alabirira okuwandiika, okukuuma n'obujjuvu bw'ebyokulabirako enkumi n'enkumi, ng'afaayo nnyo ku bujjuvu n'okusobola okugoberera. Omukugu w'obuzaale ow'e Basel, y'akakasa omutindo gw'etterekero ly'obuzaale ery'ekkampuni.
person.ursula-brunner.voce: Wa butuufu era wa mugaso, aliko akalulu aka Swiss-German, ayogera ku byokulabirako ng'obugagga obw'okukuuma.
person.ursula-brunner.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale eyasomera e Basel, yazimba okuva ku ntandikwa bayobanka ya Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1 era yagisibiza obulamu bwe bwonna.
person.dr-matthias-vogel.bio: Nga y'omukulu w'okukuuma mu bunnyogovu ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1, Matthias Vogel ye mukugu wa physics y'ebikozesebwa eyeetongodde mu kukuuma mu bbugumu eppa nnyo, avunaanyizibwa amasenero ga nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu (liquid nitrogen). Alondoola emitendera, ebbugumu ne sensa, atereeza ebikutu era ateekateeka okwerondako okukakasa nti ebyokulabirako binywevu. Okusoma kwe okwa physics kuleeta enkola ey'obwegendereza obw'ekigezo mu kuddukanya obulabe obw'omu bunnyogovu.
person.dr-matthias-vogel.voce: Wa nkola era wa mazima, annyonnyola byonna mu bbugumu, ebipimo n'ebisobozi.
person.dr-matthias-vogel.background: Yali mukugu wa physics y'ebikozesebwa, yakyuka n'agenda mu biology y'okukuuma, ng'aleeta mu cryogenics obutuufu obw'obuyinjiniya.
person.helena-roth.bio: Nga y'omukugu w'obuzaale w'ensibuko z'obuzaale ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1, Helena Roth azzaawo era anywereza ennyiriri z'Omulembe 1, obuzaale obw'omusingi obwa pulogulaamu. Adda mu nnyiriri ezoonoonese, akebera obunywevu bw'obuzaale era awandiika buli mulimu n'obutuufu. Omulimu gwe gwekuusa ku kukuuma obujjuvu bw'ensibuko z'obuzaale.
person.helena-roth.voce: Wa mugaso era wa butuufu, wa bukugu era wa bwegendereza mu kulonda ebigambo.
person.helena-roth.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale eyeetongodde mu nsibuko z'obuzaale, akolera ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1 okuzzaawo ennyiriri ez'omusingi eza Omulembe 1.
person.dr-lukas-ammann.ruolo: Omukuumi w'etterekero ly'obuzaale era omukulira okusobola okugoberera (CITES)
person.dr-lukas-ammann.bio: Nga y'omukuumi w'etterekero ly'obuzaale era omukulira olunyiriri lwa CITES ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1, Lukas Ammann addukanya erejjisita egatta buli nsolo ku kyokulabirako kyayo eky'obuzaale. Akebera enkolagana, azzaamu obuggya ebiwandiiko eby'amateeka era akuuma olunyiriri lw'okukuuma, olw'omugaso mu kugoberera amateeka ag'ensi yonna. Amanyiddwa olw'obwegendereza n'obutuufu obw'ebiwandiiko.
person.dr-lukas-ammann.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa mpisa, ayogera ku nkola n'amateeka n'obutuufu.
person.dr-lukas-ammann.background: Yeetongodde mu kuddukanya ebiwandiiko by'obuzaale n'amateeka agakuuma ebiramu, aleeta obumanyirivu obungi mu kugoberera CITES.
person.corinne-frei.bio: Nga y'omukulira omutindo n'okugoberera ku Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1, Corinne Frei yaliko omukebezi w'eby'eddagala era aleeta mu pulogulaamu omutindo omulungi ogw'enkola. Awandiika era akebera enkola, akola audit ez'omunda era awandiika buli kikyamu, ng'akakasa nti enkola z'ekifo zigoberera amateeka. Wa bwegendereza era afaayo ku kugoberera enkola z'okukola eza bulijjo.
person.corinne-frei.voce: Wa mpisa era wa butuufu, ayogera ku nkola n'ebyetaagisa, wa mukwano naye tawagira nga wabaddewo ekitali kigoberera.
person.corinne-frei.background: Yaliko omukebezi mu kitongole ky'eddagala, yakyuka n'agenda mu Eden Exotic ng'aleeta omutindo omukalu ogw'okulondoola Kifo ky'Obulunzi N.1.
person.dr-ricardo-vasquez-chavez.bio: Nga y'omukulira N.2, Ricardo akwataganya sitensoni ey'e Amazzoni eyeekuusa ku nnabbubi abasala ne ttalantula, egatta okunoonyereza ku kulaba, okukola obwoya bwa nnabbubi n'enkolagana n'abantu b'e Iquitos. Ennaku ze zigabanyizibwa wakati w'enkuŋŋaana n'abasasuli, okwekenneenya enkola z'obuzaale n'okulondoola ebibinja mu terrarium enyogezebwa. Yeewaayo okuleeta okunoonyereza okulungi n'emirimu mu Amazzoni, ng'addukanya n'obuvunaanyizibwa enkozesa y'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu ebikolebwa ekifo.
person.dr-ricardo-vasquez-chavez.voce: Ayogera n'obukkakkamu n'obukugu obw'omukulira, ng'akyusa wakati w'amalala g'ekitundu n'obwegendereza obw'ebitongole ku nkozesa ez'enkomerero.
person.dr-ricardo-vasquez-chavez.backgro: Muzzukulu wa Peru eyasomera biology mu Lima n'eyeetongodde mu aracnology ebweru w'eggwanga, yadda mu Amazzoni oluvannyuma lw'emyaka egy'okuyigiriza okuduumira ekifo ekigatta esayansi n'enkulaakulana y'ekitundu.
person.dr-ricardo-vasquez-chavez.compete: Ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu okuva mu bwoya bwa nnabbubi
person.ana-maria-rios.bio: Ana María asoma okulaba okwa langi nnya (tetrachromatic) n'obusobozi bw'okugonjoola ebizibu obwa nnabbubi abasala aba N.2, ng'akola obuzimbe obutono n'ebigezo by'okulonda okutegeera engeri gye bateekateeka okugwira. Amala essaawa ng'ali ku microscope n'okwekenneenya vidiyo enkendevu, ng'awandiika buli kutambula kw'eriiso na buli kubuuka okubalirirwa. Asikirizibwa endowooza ey'«omukutu ogulaba» n'okulaba okw'ekitalo okwa nnabbubi bano.
person.ana-maria-rios.voce: Ajjudde essanyu era wa bwegendereza, ayaka ng'annyonnyola ebikwata era akozesa ebifaananyi eby'okulaba.
person.ana-maria-rios.background: Omukugu wa ethology owa Peru alina PhD mu nneeyisa y'ensolo, yajja ku N.2 nga asikirizibwa okusobola okusoma amagezi g'obunnabbubi obusala n'ebikozesebwa yunivasite gyetaali gisobola.
person.ing-julio-herrera.ruolo: Omukulira ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu n'okukola obwoya bwa nnabbubi
person.ing-julio-herrera.bio: Julio ye nyinjiniya akola okuleeta obwoya bwa nnabbubi okuva ku kigero kya laabu okutuuka ku kigero ky'amakolero, n'obuwuzi obw'okukolwa (recombinant), okuluka mu mazzi n'ebigezo by'okusika. Eri N.2 y'akiiraga ekitundu ky'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu n'obwannannyini bw'ebirowoozo: ebintu ebyereevu era eby'amaanyi ebiyinza okudda mu kifo ky'obuwuzi obwonoona obutonde. Alaba mu paatente omukisa gw'enkulaakulana ya tekinologiya eri Peru.
person.ing-julio-herrera.voce: Wa mazima era ajjudde essanyu ng'enyinjiniya, ayogera ku bikolwa, ebbeeyi n'paatente.
person.ing-julio-herrera.background: Nyinjiniya w'ebikozesebwa owa Peru, oluvannyuma lw'obumanyirivu mu makolero g'engoye ne polymers, yakyuka n'agenda mu kunoonyereza ku bikozesebwa eby'obulamu ng'anoonya pulojekiti egatta okukuuma obutonde n'omuwendo gw'obusuubuzi.
person.carla-tuesta.bio: Carla ye mukugu w'obuzaale akozesa Protocolli C ne D ku bunnabbubi obusala, ng'ateekamu enkyukakyuka entuufu n'obwegendereza obungi era ng'awandiika bulungi buli mutendera. Ennaku ze zijjudde okusoma obuzaale (sequencing), okulunda obutoffaali n'okwekenneenya data n'obwegendereza. Amanyiddwa olw'obwegendereza obw'obusayansi n'obutuufu obw'ebiwandiiko by'okugezesa.
person.carla-tuesta.voce: Wa mugaso era wa bwegendereza, alonda ebigambo n'obwegendereza era akuuma eddoboozi ery'obukugu.
person.carla-tuesta.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale owa Peru eyasomera wakati wa Lima ne PhD ebweru w'eggwanga, yayingira N.2 okukola ku kukyusa obuzaale bwa nnabbubi abasala.
person.manuel-shapiama.bio: Manuel ye mukozi w'oku ttale owa N.2, eyakulira mu kibira era asobola okuzuula nnabbubi abasala ne ttalantula abalala we balaba obususu n'amakoola gokka. Ategeka olugendo olw'okukuŋŋaanya, ategeka ebisenero era aleetera abanoonyereza okumanya okw'omukono okw'ekibira, okuva ku makubo amateefu okutuuka ku bika eby'okussa ekitiibwa. Aleeta ensolo ez'omu nsiko ezeetaagisa laabu era wa mugaso ennyo mu mulimu ogw'oku ttale.
person.manuel-shapiama.voce: Ayogera mu ngeri ennyangu era ey'amazima, ejjudde ebikwata ku kibira.
person.manuel-shapiama.background: Muzzukulu wa Peru ow'ekika ky'omu Amazzoni, yayiga ekibira okuva mu maka nga tannaba kufuuka mukozi w'oku ttale owa sitensoni, obukugu bwe obw'omukono we bwetaagisibwa nnyo.
person.manuel-shapiama.competenze: Enkola z'oku ttale mu kibira eky'enkuba
person.dr-haruki-tanaka.bio: Nga y'omukulira N.3, Haruki akulembera sitensoni ey'e Japani eyeekuusa ku amphibians naddala axolotl, ng'akwataganya okunoonyereza ku kuzzaawo, eby'obusawo bw'ensolo n'enkola z'obuzaale. Ennaku ze zitandika mangu, ng'akebera amasenero, n'agenda mu maaso n'okwekenneenya data n'okuwabula ku bwegendereza obw'okugezesa. Akkiriza nti okutegeera okuzzaawo okwa amphibians kuyinza okuyamba obujjanjabi bw'omuntu.
person.dr-haruki-tanaka.voce: Wa mukkakkamu era alowooza, aliko obwegendereza obufugibwa; ayogera ku kuzzaawo ng'ekisuubizo eri obujjanjabi.
person.dr-haruki-tanaka.background: Omukugu w'ebyewalula ava Hokkaidō, oluvannyuma lw'okusoma wakati wa Japani n'enkolagana ez'ensi yonna, yasalawo okuwaayo obulamu bwe eri axolotl ng'ekisumuluzo ky'obujjanjabi obuzzaawo.
person.yumi-sato.bio: Yumi asoma engeri salamanders ne newts gye zizzaawo amagulu, emikira n'ebitundu ebifiiridde, ng'azzaawo mutendera ku mutendera olunyiriri lw'obutoffaali olw'okuzzaawo. Amala ennaku ng'ali mu kulunda blastema, microscopy n'okwetegereza kwa time-lapse. Omulimu gwe gugendereza okuvvuunula enkola z'okuzzaawo eza amphibians okufuuka amatiku eri obujjanjabi bw'omuntu.
person.yumi-sato.voce: Wa maanyi era wa bugumu, agatta esayansi n'ebiyinza okuvaamu eri abantu.
person.yumi-sato.background: Omukugu wa biology owa Japani eyeetongodde mu bujjanjabi obuzzaawo, yakyusa okunoonyereza kwe okudda ku amphibians n'enkola z'okuzza ebitundu.
person.dr-kenji-nakamura.bio: Kenji ye mukugu w'obuzaale owa N.3 asoma obuzaale bw'okuzzaawo obugabanibwa wakati wa amphibians n'ebisolo ebiyonsa, ng'anoonya enkola z'obutoffaali ezikola mu axolotl naye ezisirikira mu muntu. Akolera wakati w'okwekenneenya obuzaale n'okugezesa okw'okulaga obuzaale, era mu nkuŋŋaana asaba data ennyingi nga tebannaba kugenda mu maaso. Ye mukuumi w'obwegendereza obw'okugezesa mu kibinja.
person.dr-kenji-nakamura.voce: Wa kwekenneenya era wa bwegendereza, ayogera ku mbeera n'ebisembayo; ye ddoboozi eriyita mu bwegendereza.
person.dr-kenji-nakamura.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale owa Japani alina okusoma okunywevu mu genomics ey'okwenkanya, yayingira N.3 okusoma emisingi gy'obutoffaali egy'okuzzaawo wakati w'ebika eby'enjawulo.
person.aiko-ishikawa.bio: Aiko ye musawo avunaanyizibwa obulungi bw'ebibinja bya amphibians eby'N.3, ebiramu ebinafu ennyo ebikwatibwa buli nkyukakyuka y'ebbugumu, omutindo gw'amazzi oba okunyigirizibwa. Alondoola ebipimo, ajjanjaba obulwadde bw'olususu era alongoosa omutindo gw'okulunda, ng'akkiriza nti ensolo ennamu zizaala esayansi ey'okwesigwa. Alwanirira n'amaanyi embeera z'okulunda.
person.aiko-ishikawa.voce: Wa maanyi era wa kukuuma, ayogera mu ngeri ey'obusawo ey'amazima; afaayo ku bulamu bw'ensolo.
person.aiko-ishikawa.background: Omusawo w'ensolo owa Japani eyeetongodde mu nsolo ez'enjawulo n'ez'omu laabu, yalonda amphibians olw'okusoomooza okw'obusawo okuva mu byetaago byazo ebinafu.
person.sora-yoshida.bio: Sora ye mukozi w'obulunzi owa N.3, avunaanyizibwa obulamu obwa buli lunaku obwa amphibians: addukanya amasenero, ebisengejja, emitendera gy'okuwaguza olususu n'okuliisa n'obwegendereza obungi. Amanyi buli ddoboozi ery'ppampu na buli nkyukakyuka y'amazzi, ng'akola sensa nga tezinnalaga kizibu. Obukugu bwe obw'omukono bwetaagisa nnyo eri ebibinja by'ekifo.
person.sora-yoshida.voce: Wa mugaso era wa mazima, ayogera ku mirimu n'enkola eza bulijjo, n'obunyiikivu obw'obuteesa.
person.sora-yoshida.background: Omukozi owa Japani alina obumanyirivu mu bulunzi bw'eby'omu mazzi (aquaculture) n'okulunda ebyewalula, yayingira N.3 okuddukanya embeera z'okulunda amphibians ag'okunoonyereza.
person.dr-arjun-nair.bio: Nga y'omukulira N.5, Arjun akulembera sitensoni ey'e Buyindi eyeekuusa ku misota, okunoonyereza ku busagwa we kubunye okuva ku ddagala eriwonya obulamu okutuuka ku nkozesa z'okwerinda. Ennaku ze zigabanyizibwa wakati w'ekifo ky'emisota (serpentario), laabu za biochemistry n'okukwataganya enkolagana n'ebitongole. Alaga pulogulaamu ng'okunoonyereza ku ddagala eriziyiza obusagwa n'eddagala, nga kwongeddwako ekitundu eky'enkozesa ebbiri ekiddukanyibwa n'obuvunaanyizibwa.
person.dr-arjun-nair.voce: Alowooza era ayogera bulungi, awakanya n'amagezi n'okufaayo ku nsonga z'empisa ez'omulimu.
person.dr-arjun-nair.background: Omukugu w'ebyewalula ava Kerala, eyasomera mu Buyindi n'eyeetongodde mu biology y'emisota, yatuuka ku bukulembeze bwa N.5 ng'asindiikirizibwa okwegomba okukola eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa erisinga obulungi eri ekitundu.
person.priya-menon.bio: Priya ye mukugu wa biochemistry y'obusagwa owa N.5, agabanya obutwa, akola maapu ya peptides era azuula molekyu ezirina obusobozi obw'okuwonya obulumi, puleesa oba okukwata kw'omusaayi. Gy'ali buli busagwa kye kitabo ky'eddagala ekyakula okumala emyaka obukadde n'obukadde, ekibinja ky'ebisumuluzo eby'obutoffaali eby'okusoma n'ekitiibwa. Omulimu gwe guwagira okunoonyereza kw'eddagala okuva mu butwa.
person.priya-menon.voce: Wa butuufu era ayagala molekyu, ng'oyandiggamba nga ayimba ng'ayogera ku butwa ng'eddagala.
person.priya-menon.background: Omukugu wa biochemistry owa Buyindi alina PhD mu pharmacology y'obutoffaali, yalonda okusoma obusagwa olw'obusobozi bwabwo obungi obw'okuwonya.
person.dr-vikram-deshpande.bio: Vikram ye mukugu wa pharmacology avvuunula obutwa obwakolebwako bannaabwe okubufuula ebiyinza okuwonya, ng'ateekateeka ebigezo by'obusobozi, okusoma emigero (dose) n'engeri z'obutwa. Ennaku ze zijjudde okusoma emabega n'ebiva mu dose (dose-response), enkola z'obutoffaali n'okuteekateeka ennyiriri z'okukola eddagala. Ye kitundu ky'eddagala n'okuvvuunula okwa pulogulaamu.
person.dr-vikram-deshpande.voce: Wa nkola era wa butuufu, ayagala okwogera ku bujjanjabi n'engeri gye bikola.
person.dr-vikram-deshpande.background: Omukugu wa pharmacology owa Buyindi alina obumanyirivu mu makolero g'eddagala, yakyuka n'agenda mu N.5 ng'asikirizibwa obusobozi bw'obutwa obw'okuwonya n'eddembe ery'okunoonyereza edda(ekifo we liwa).
person.lakshmi-iyer.ruolo: Omukugu w'ebyewalula era omukulira ekifo ky'emisota
person.lakshmi-iyer.bio: Lakshmi ye mukugu w'ebyewalula alabirira emisota egy'omu kifo ky'emisota ekya N.5, ng'agikwata n'obukugu obungi n'ekitiibwa. Addukanya okuliisa, okuwaguza olususu, okwewala endwadde n'okuzaala, ng'amanyi empisa ya buli musota. Yayingira pulogulaamu olw'okukuuma ebika ebisangibwa mu Ghati Occidentali gyokka.
person.lakshmi-iyer.voce: Wa bukkakkamu era wa kitiibwa, ayogera ku misota n'obukugu n'okufaayo ku kitiibwa kyagyo.
person.lakshmi-iyer.background: Omukugu w'ebyewalula owa Buyindi ayagala obwaddundi bw'ebiramu, yatuuka ku N.5 n'ekigendererwa eky'okukuuma emisota egisangibwa mu Ghati Occidentali gyokka.
person.suresh-gowda.bio: Suresh ye mukozi avunaanyizibwa okuggya obusagwa ku N.5, omulimu gw'akola okumala emyaka amakumi abiri n'obukkakkamu n'obwesige. Anywereza emisota, akuŋŋaanya obusagwa ku ndabirwamu era abukaza mu ngeri entuufu era ey'obwangu. Obumanyirivu bwe obungi obw'omukono bumufuula omuntu omukulu mu lunyiriri lw'okukola obusagwa.
person.suresh-gowda.voce: Wa bigambo bitono era wa mazima, ayogera n'obumanyirivu obw'omukono n'engero ez'omulimu.
person.suresh-gowda.background: Omukozi owa Buyindi ow'e Karnataka alina obumanyirivu obw'emyaka mingi obw'omukono mu kuggya obusagwa, yayiga omulimu oku ttale okusinga mu bitabo.
person.dr-bagus-wijaya.bio: Nga y'omukulira N.7, Bagus akulembera sitensoni ey'e Indoneziya eyeekuusa ku byewalula eby'omu nnyanja n'enfudu, n'okunoonyereza ku kutereeza omunnyo, okulaga ekkubo n'obuwangaazi. Ennaku ze zigabanyizibwa wakati w'amasenero g'oku lubalama, olugendo ku nnyanja n'enkolagana n'ebitongole. Amutwala okwagala okungi ku by'enjawulo eby'omu nnyanja n'omugaso okutegeera kwazo kuyinza okuleeta eri okukuuma ebiramu.
person.dr-bagus-wijaya.voce: Wa mukwano era wa maanyi, ayogera n'essanyu ku nnyanja n'obuwangaazi.
person.dr-bagus-wijaya.background: Omukugu wa biology y'omu nnyanja ava Sulawesi, yazimba omulimu gwe ng'asoma obutonde obw'oku lubalama obwa Indoneziya nga tannaba kukwata bukulembeze bwa N.7.
person.sri-wulandari.bio: Sri asoma engeri ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja n'enfudu gye ziwonera mu mazzi ag'omunnyo, ng'assa essira ku bisenge by'omunnyo n'enkola entono ez'okutereeza omunnyo. Amala ennaku ng'agya omusaayi, apima electrolytes era akola enkola z'obwenkanya bw'amazzi. Aloota engeri ebyetereeza bino gye biyinza okuleeta amagezi ku bbula ly'amazzi mu nsi ebugumu.
person.sri-wulandari.voce: Alowooza era atunuulira ebiseera eby'omu maaso, agatta emirundi mingi physiology y'ebyewalula ku nsonga ennene ez'ekizibu ky'amazzi mu bantu.
person.sri-wulandari.background: Omukugu wa physiology owa Indoneziya eyeetongodde mu byetereeza by'ensolo ez'omu nnyanja, yatuuka ku N.7 ng'ayagala engeri z'okuwona mu mbeera y'omunnyo.
person.dr-yusuf-maulana.bio: Yusuf asoma engeri enfudu ez'omu nnyanja gye zizuula ekkubo nga ziyita mu bikumi by'obukiro eby'ennyanja, nga zidda ku lubalama lwennyini kwe zaazaalirwa. Ennaku ze zijjudde data z'oku satlaayiti, okugezesa ku magineeti n'okwetegereza obwana obwaakava mu magi nga bugenda ku nnyanja. Asikirizibwa okuwulira magineeti (magnetoreception), obusobozi bw'okuwulira magineeti w'ensi ng'amaapu era ng'okompasi awamu.
person.dr-yusuf-maulana.voce: Wa kwagala okumanya era ajjudde essanyu, yeebuza mu kunnyonnyola okusikiriza ku kompasi ez'obulamu n'amaapu ga magineeti.
person.dr-yusuf-maulana.background: Omukugu wa biology owa Indoneziya eyeetongodde mu nneeyisa n'okuzuula ekkubo kw'ensolo, yayingira N.7 ng'asikirizibwa ekyama ky'okulaga ekkubo kw'enfudu ez'omu nnyanja.
person.ni-made-ayu.bio: Ni Made ye mukugu w'obuzaale w'obuwangaazi owa N.7, akola ku Protocollo H ng'asoma enfudu n'ensolo ezikaddiwa mpola nnyo ennyo. Amala ennaku ng'akwekenneenya telomeres, obubonero bw'obukadde (senescence) n'okugeraageranya abato n'abawangaazi. Anoonya obuzaale obukendeeza ku budde obw'obulamu.
person.ni-made-ayu.voce: Wa magezi era ajjudde essanyu, ayogera ku bukadde ng'ekizibu ekiyinza okugonjoolwa mu byobusayansi.
person.ni-made-ayu.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale owa Indoneziya, oboolyawo owa Bali, eyeetongodde mu biology y'obukadde, yatuuka ku N.7 okusoma ensolo ez'omu nnyanja ez'obuwangaazi obungi.
person.hasan-lampe.bio: Hasan ye mukozi w'oku ttale ow'omu nnyanja owa N.7, eyaliko omuvubi ow'Ennyanja ya Banda eyakyusa okumanya ennyanja okufuuka omulimu munda mu sitensoni. Addukanya amasenero g'oku lubalama, ategeka okununula ku nnyanja era avuga eryato n'obwesige obw'omuntu eyamala obulamu bwe ku mazzi. Amanyi amayengo, okusika n'okusika kw'ennyanja n'enneeyisa y'ensolo, era wa mugaso mu mulimu ogw'oku ttale.
person.hasan-lampe.voce: Wa butereevu era wa mazima, ayogera n'obuyinza obw'omusajja w'ennyanja, ng'agatta obumanyirivu obw'omuvubi n'okwagala okukalu okw'ensolo.
person.hasan-lampe.background: Muzzukulu wa Indoneziya eyaliko omuvubi ow'Ennyanja ya Banda, yateeka obumanyirivu bwe obw'ennyanja mu mulimu gwa N.7 ng'omukozi w'oku ttale.
person.dr-joseph-okello.ruolo: Omukulira Ekifo ky'Obulunzi n'sitensoni ey'oku ttale
person.dr-joseph-okello.bio: Nga y'omukulira N.8, Joseph akulembera sitensoni ey'e Uganda eyeekuusa ku nnankinsooki, egatta okunoonyereza ku kwekweka, obuzaale bw'obutoffaali obukyusa langi n'pulogulaamu enywevu ey'okukuuma oku ttale. Ennaku ze zikyusaakyusa wakati w'okuddukanya sitensoni, olugendo mu bibira eby'ekitundu n'enkuŋŋaana n'ebitongole. Assa essira ery'amaanyi ku kitundu eky'okukuuma ebiramu ekya pulojekiti n'okukuuma ebika ebiri mu kabi.
person.dr-joseph-okello.voce: Wa bwesige era ateekateeka bulungi, ayogera bulungi ku kukuuma ebiramu n'okunoonyereza.
person.dr-joseph-okello.background: Omukugu w'ensolo (zoologist) owa Uganda eyasomera wakati wa Kampala n'ebitongole eby'ensi yonna, yazimba omulimu gwe ng'agatta okunoonyereza n'okukuuma ebiramu eby'e Afirika ey'ebuvanjuba.
person.grace-nakato.bio: Grace asoma okukyusa langi kwa nnankinsooki, ng'anoonyereza engeri obutoffaali obukyusa langi (chromatophores) ne kristaalo za langi (photonic crystals) ez'olususu gye zikolamu enkyukakyuka ya langi olw'okuwuliziganya, okutereeza ebbugumu n'okwekweka. Amala ennaku ng'akwetegereza enneeyisa, spectrophotometry y'olususu n'okwekenneenya engeri ensolo gy'efuga langi yaayo. Annyonnyola nnankinsooki nga «ekiwanika ekiramu», engulu erongoosa n'okwolesa amawulire.
person.grace-nakato.voce: Wa kwewuunya era annyonnyola bulungi, akozesa ebifaananyi ebijjuvu ng'«ekiwanika ekiramu».
person.grace-nakato.background: Omukugu wa biology owa Uganda eyeetongodde mu physiology n'enneeyisa, yeewaayo ku nnankinsooki ng'asikirizibwa enkola z'okukyusa langi kwazo.
person.dr-samuel-mugisha.ruolo: Omukugu w'obutonde ow'oku ttale era omukulira okukuuma ebiramu
person.dr-samuel-mugisha.bio: Samuel ye mukugu w'obutonde ow'oku ttale owa N.8, agabanya ebiseera bye wakati wa sitensoni n'ebibira eby'e Uganda ebimenyekamenyeka nnankinsooki mwe zibeera. Akola okubala, akola maapu z'ebifo, alondoola ebibinja era akolagana ne Eden okuteeka eby'obugagga ku kukuuma ebiramu okw'amazima. Amanyi abantu ab'ekyalo, ng'akitegeera nti okukuuma ebifo kuyita mu kubatwaliramu.
person.dr-samuel-mugisha.voce: Wa mazima era ayagala ekitundu, ayogera ku bibira n'abantu n'obwangu; wa mazima ku kukuuma ebiramu.
person.dr-samuel-mugisha.background: Omukugu w'obutonde owa Uganda eyeewaddeyo ku kukuuma ebiramu, yalonda okukolagana ne N.8 okusobola okufuna eby'obugagga eby'okukuuma ebifo eby'ebibira ebiri mu kabi.
person.aisha-namuli.bio: Aisha ye mukugu w'obuzaale omuto owa N.8 akozesa Protocolli B ne C ku butoffaali obukyusa langi obwa nnankinsooki, ng'asoma era ng'akyusa obuzaale obufuga langi y'olususu. Ennaku ze zijjudde okukyusa obuzaale, okwekenneenya okulaga obuzaale n'okulunda obutoffaali, byonna nga akola n'amaanyi n'okwegomba. Ye munoonyereza omuyivu eyesse essira ku kusoomooza okwa tekinologiya.
person.aisha-namuli.voce: Wa maanyi era ayagala okugenda mu maaso, ayogera n'obwesige obw'obukugu n'amaanyi g'obuvubuka.
person.aisha-namuli.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale omuto omuyivu owa Uganda, eyasomera mu biology y'obutoffaali, yayingira N.8 ng'akiraba ng'omukisa ogw'ekitalo ogw'omulimu.
person.peter-ssemwanga.bio: Peter ye mukozi w'oku ttale owa N.8, avunaanyizibwa terrari ne kkamera z'ebifaananyi (fototrappole) ezikwata nnankinsooki mu buggya ne mu nsiko. Azimba era akuuma ebifo ebikoleddwa, afaayo ku kuliisa era akuŋŋaanya ebifaananyi okuva mu kkamera n'obugumiikiriza obw'oyo amanyi obudde obw'ebiseera ebyeeyongera obw'ensolo zino. Amanyi obulungi buli nsolo eri mu terrarium era wa mugaso mu mulimu ogw'okwetegereza.
person.peter-ssemwanga.voce: Wa bbugumu era annyonnyola bulungi, ayogera ku nnankinsooki n'okwagala n'okufaayo ku bikwata.
person.peter-ssemwanga.background: Omukozi owa Uganda ow'ekitundu, yayigira oku ttale okulabirira ebyewalula n'okuddukanya terrari n'afuuka wa mugaso ennyo eri N.8.
person.astrid-lindqvist.bio: Nga y'omukulira Ekifo N.9 mu Kiruna, Astrid Lindqvist akulembera data center ekola enkola ey'omukutu gwonna ogw'obuzaale ogwa Eden Exotic. Akwataganya abakugu ba bioinformatics n'abayinjiniya, ateekawo ebikulembezza eby'enkola era agatta data eziva mu bifo byonna. Ekigendererwa kye kwe kufuula data ebikozesebwa eby'okutegeera biology y'ensolo.
person.astrid-lindqvist.voce: Wa magezi era alowooza, annyonnyola enkola enzibu mu ngeri etegeerekeka.
person.astrid-lindqvist.background: Omukugu wa bioinformatics eyasomera mu bukiikakkono, yazimba mu Kiruna ekifo ky'okubalirira ky'aduumira kaakati, ku nkolagana wakati wa data ne biology.
person.dr-erik-johansson.ruolo: Omukulira machine learning ne data science
person.dr-erik-johansson.bio: Nga y'omukulira ML ne data science ku Kifo N.9, Erik Johansson azimba enkola z'obwongo (neural networks) eziraga ebiva mu kukyusa obuzaale nga tekinnakolebwa. Atendeka enkola, alongoosa ebipimo era akakasa ebiragulwa ng'ageraageranya ne data z'okugezesa. Omulimu gwe gufuula okuteekateeka enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale okuba okw'obwangu era okw'ekigendererwa.
person.dr-erik-johansson.voce: Wa kwekenneenya era ayagala enkola, ayogera ku bipimo n'ensengeka.
person.dr-erik-johansson.background: Omukugu wa data science eyeetongodde mu machine learning, yayingira Ekifo N.9 okukozesa machine learning mu kuragula obuzaale.
person.maja-bergstrom.bio: Nga y'omukugu wa genomics ey'okubalirira ku Kifo N.9, Maja Bergström akwekenneenya obuzaale bw'ensolo okuzuula emisingi gy'obuzaale egy'engeri z'omubiri empya ezivaayo. Ageraageranya ennyiriri z'obuzaale, azuula ebitundu ebikuumibwa era agatta enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale ku ngeri eziraba. Amutwala okwagala okumanya okungi ku buzaale bw'engeri enzibu.
person.maja-bergstrom.voce: Wa kwagala okumanya era ajjudde essanyu, ayaka ng'anyumya ebifaananyi n'enkolagana.
person.maja-bergstrom.background: Omunoonyereza mu genomics ey'okubalirira, yatuuka ku Kifo N.9 okusoma emisingi gy'obuzaale egy'engeri z'omubiri empya ezivaayo.
person.dr-nils-andersson.bio: Nga y'omukulira ebyuma ne data center ku Kifo N.9, Nils Andersson addukanya ekyuma ekiramu enkola yonna ey'obuzaale eya Eden Exotic kwe zikolera. Afaayo ku seva, okunyogeza, amasannyalaze n'okugenda mu maaso okw'emirimu, ng'akozesa embeera y'obunnyogovu obwa Lapland okuggyawo ebbugumu ery'ebisenge by'okubalirira. Akakasa obwesige n'okukozesa amasannyalaze mu ngeri ennungi.
person.dr-nils-andersson.voce: Wa mazima era wa mugaso, ayogera ku maanyi, okunyogeza n'obwesige.
person.dr-nils-andersson.background: Nyinjiniya w'ebyuma bya kompyuta, yakola era addukanya data center eya Kifo N.9 ng'akozesa embeera y'omu bukiikakkono okunyogeza.
person.sofia-kallio.bio: Nga y'omukulira pulogulaamu ey'okwetereeza mu bunnyogovu ku Kifo N.9, Sofia Kallio akola enkola z'engeri ebiramu gye bigumira ebbugumu eppa. Asoma puloteyina eziziyiza obunnyogovu (antifreeze proteins), engeri obutoffaali gye bwolekagana n'obunnyogovu n'engeri z'okwekuuma mu bunnyogovu. Okunoonyereza kwe kulina omugaso mu kugumira embeera enkambwe.
person.sofia-kallio.voce: Wa mirembe era ajjudde essanyu, ayogera ku bunnyogovu n'okwetereeza n'okwagala okumpi ng'oyimba.
person.sofia-kallio.background: Omukugu wa biology eyeetongodde mu byetereeza by'ebbugumu eppa, yasanga mu Kifo N.9 ekifo ekituufu okusoma okugumira obunnyogovu.
person.col-ris-james-whitaker.ruolo: Omukulira Ekifo era omukulira Programma Sigma
person.col-ris-james-whitaker.bio: Nga y'omukulira ekifo N.10 ne Programma Sigma, kanoni eyawummula James Whitaker akulembera ekitundu eky'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) ekya Eden Exotic. Akwataganya okukakasa, enkolagana n'abasaba n'ebikulembezza eby'omu mirimu, nga byolekedde okukola enkola z'obulamu ezigumu olw'enkozesa z'okwerinda, embeera enkambwe n'obuyambi. Akulembera pulogulaamu nga bwe kigobererwa obuvunaanyizibwa, okulabirira n'okwetegeka.
person.col-ris-james-whitaker.voce: Wa mugaso era wa maanyi, ayogera ku bigendererwa n'okwetegeka, n'obukkakkamu obw'ofisa omukugu.
person.col-ris-james-whitaker.background: Ofisa eyawummula alina obumanyirivu obungi obw'omu mirimu, aduumira ekifo N.10 ng'aleeta mu Programma Sigma endowooza eyolekedde okwetegeka n'okukuuma.
person.dr-daniel-cole.bio: Nga y'omukulira okukakasa oku ttale ku kifo N.10, Daniel Cole apima era akakasa obusobozi bw'ensolo obw'okukola emirimu ng'ayita mu bigezo, ebipimo n'enkola. Ateekateeka ebigezo, akuŋŋaanya data z'obusobozi era awandiika ebivaamu nga bwe kigobererwa amateeka amakalu. Amanyiddwa olw'obutuufu obw'enkola n'okufaayo ku nkola.
person.dr-daniel-cole.voce: Wa bukugu era wa butuufu, ayogera ku bipimo n'enkola, n'okufaayo ku ngeri.
person.dr-daniel-cole.background: Omukugu w'okukakasa n'okugezesa alina obumanyirivu obw'omu mirimu, yateekebwa ku kifo N.10 okukakasa ensolo nga bwe kigobererwa enkola za Programma Sigma.
person.rebecca-hayes.bio: Nga y'omukulira okwerinda okw'omu mirimu ku kifo N.10, Rebecca Hayes akuuma Programma Sigma okuva ku kufuluma kw'amawulire n'okuyingira. Addukanya okuyingira, enkola z'obwama, okulwanyisa okwekwekereza n'okwekenneenya ebifo ebinafu, ng'akakasa nti pulogulaamu ekola mu mbeera etekuumibwa era efugibwa. Wa bwegendereza era wa butuufu mu kukuuma amawulire amazibu.
person.rebecca-hayes.voce: Wa maanyi era wa masso, ayogera ku bulabe n'ebiziyiza, wa mukwano era wa bwegendereza.
person.rebecca-hayes.background: Omukugu w'okwerinda alina obumanyirivu mu bifo ebizibu, akuuma ekifo N.10 okukuuma Programma Sigma okuva ku kwolesebwa okutasaana.
person.marcus-bennett.ruolo: Omukulira okugatta mu nkola n'enkolagana n'eby'okwerinda
person.marcus-bennett.bio: Nga y'omukulira okugatta mu nkola n'eby'okwerinda ku kifo N.10, Marcus Bennett ye kifo eky'okukwatagana wakati wa Eden Exotic n'abasaba ab'ebitongole aba Programma Sigma. Afaayo ku nkolagana, ategeka ebiwandiiko era akubaganya ebirowoozo ku ndagaano, ng'annyonnyola engeri y'enkozesa ebbiri eya pulogulaamu n'enkozesa zaayo ez'okukuuma. Wa bukugu mu kuwuliziganya n'okuzimba enkolagana n'ebitongole.
person.marcus-bennett.voce: Wa bwesige era wa kusendasenda, ayogera ku mikisa n'emigaso, wa mukwano era awummuza.
person.marcus-bennett.background: Omukugu mu kukulaakulanya n'enkolagana n'ebitongole alina obumanyirivu mu kitongole ky'okwerinda, akwataganya Eden n'abasaba ba Programma Sigma.
person.karen-foster.bio: Nga y'omukulira empisa n'okugoberera okw'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) ku kifo N.10, Karen Foster alabirira okwekenneenya kw'empisa okw'emirimu gya Programma Sigma. Akebera ebiteeso, awandiika endowooza era yeetaba mu nkuŋŋaana ez'okusalawo ng'eddoboozi ery'enfuga, ng'akakasa nti okunoonyereza okw'enkozesa ebbiri kukolebwa mu nsalo ez'obuvunaanyizibwa. Omulimu gwe gukakasa okulabirira empisa okwa pulogulaamu.
person.karen-foster.voce: Wa kuwakanya era alowooza, apima buli nsonga n'obwegendereza n'okufaayo ku bivaamu.
person.karen-foster.background: Omukugu w'empisa n'okugoberera alina okusoma mu nfuga y'okunoonyereza okuzibu, akuuma ku kifo N.10 enkola y'empisa eya Programma Sigma ey'enkozesa ebbiri.
person.dr-etienne-lefevre.bio: Nga y'omukulira eyalondebwa owa N.11, Étienne ye mukugu wa neuroethology owa Bufalansa eyayitibwa okutandikawo ekitundu ky'ennyonyi ekyeekuusa ku namuŋŋoona n'enkusu, ekyeekuusa ku kusoma olulimi olutali lw'omuntu n'amagezi. Mu kiseera kino eky'okutandika afaayo ku kuteekateeka ebisulo by'ennyonyi (voliere), okulonda ekibinja n'okuteekawo enkola z'okunoonyereza. Asikirizibwa okuwuliziganya wakati w'ebika eby'enjawulo n'obusobozi bw'amagezi obw'ennyonyi.
person.dr-etienne-lefevre.voce: Wa kitiibwa era mutabaganya, ayogera ng'omuyivu w'olulimi n'amagezi.
person.dr-etienne-lefevre.background: Omukugu wa neuroethology owa Bufalansa eyasomera mu sayansi z'amagezi n'enneeyisa, yalondebwa okutandikawo ekitundu ky'ennyonyi ekya N.11 mu New Caledonia.
person.marie-wamytan.bio: Marie ye mukugu w'ennyonyi (ornithologist) owa Kanak asoma namuŋŋoona za N.11, naddala obusobozi obw'ekitalo obw'amagezi n'okukozesa ebikozesebwa obwa namuŋŋoona za New Caledonia. Amala ennaku ng'akwetegereza oku ttale, ng'akola ebigezo by'amagezi n'ng'alabirira ennyonyi, ekika ekiva mu bizinga bye. Yayingira pulogulaamu n'ekigendererwa eky'amaanyi eky'okukuuma ebiramu.
person.marie-wamytan.voce: Anywedde mu kitundu era ajjudde essanyu, ayogera ku namuŋŋoona n'amalala ag'ekika kya Kanak.
person.marie-wamytan.background: Omukugu w'ennyonyi owa Kanak owa New Caledonia, yasoma ennyonyi ez'ebizinga bye era yayingira N.11 okukuuma namuŋŋoona ez'ekitundu.
person.dr-julien-moreau.bio: Julien asoma bioacustica n'okwefaananyiriza amaloboozi okwa nkusu, ng'anoonyereza engeri gye zisobola okuzza buli ddoboozi n'obutuufu obw'ekitalo. Ennaku ze zijjudde okukwata amaloboozi, spectrograms n'okwekenneenya engeri obwongo gye bufuga eddoboozi, ng'anoonya enkola ezifuula ennyonyi okusobola okuzza eddoboozi ly'omuntu. Annyonnyola obusobozi buno nga «ekirabo eky'okwogera n'akamwa k'omulala».
person.dr-julien-moreau.voce: Asikirizibwa era ayagala okumanya, akozesa ebifaananyi ebisikiriza ng'«okwogera n'akamwa k'omulala».
person.dr-julien-moreau.background: Omukugu wa bioacustica owa Bufalansa eyeetongodde mu kuvuga n'okwefaananyiriza amaloboozi mu nnyonyi, yayingira N.11 okusoma okwefaananyiriza okw'ekitalo okw'enkusu.
person.lea-poadja.bio: Léa asoma enneeyisa n'obwesimbu mu nnyonyi, naddala engeri namuŋŋoona n'enkusu gye zizuula era gye zeefaananyiriza abantu ssekinnoomu, nga zawula munnaawe ku mugenyi oba eddoboozi ku ddoboozi eddala. Amala ennaku ng'akola ebigezo by'okuzuula, playback y'amaloboozi n'okwekenneenya emikutu gy'obwenkanya obw'ennyonyi. Asikirizibwa engeri obwongo bw'ennyonyi gye buzimba endowooza y'obwesimbu.
person.lea-poadja.voce: Wa kwagala okumanya era wa kuwulira, ayogera n'essanyu ku bwesimbu n'okuzuula.
person.lea-poadja.background: Omunoonyereza owa New Caledonia eyeetongodde mu nneeyisa y'ensolo, yatuuka ku N.11 ng'ayagala okuzuula omuntu ssekinnoomu n'obwesimbu mu nnyonyi.
person.paul-nechero.bio: Paul ye mukozi w'ebisulo by'ennyonyi owa N.11, muzzukulu wa Kanak ow'ekitundu azimba, atereeza era akuuma ebisulo namuŋŋoona n'enkusu mwe zibeera. Ateekateeka ebizimbe ebissa ekitiibwa ku byetaago by'ennyonyi, afaayo ku kuliisa n'okugaggawaza obutonde era akwetegereza abagenyi be n'okwetegereza okunywedde mu buwangwa bw'ekitundu. Gy'ali okulabirira ebisulo mulimu gwa buvunaanyizibwa n'ekitiibwa.
person.paul-nechero.voce: Wa mirembe era wa kitiibwa, ayogera ku nnyonyi n'ekitiibwa ekinywedde mu buwangwa bwa Kanak, awatali bukugu bwa bwereere.
person.paul-nechero.background: Omukozi wa Kanak owa New Caledonia, yagatta okumanya okw'ennono okw'ekitundu kye n'okulabirira okw'omukono okw'ebisulo bya N.11.
person.lena-amupolo.bio: Akulembera okuteekateeka n'okutandika Ekifo ky'Obulunzi N.12 mu ddungu lya Namib, ekyeekuusa ku nkonkoma n'ebyewalula ebyagala okukala. Akwataganya okuteeka enkola z'okulunda, okuteekateeka okuzimba n'okutandika ennyiriri ezisooka. Yafuna obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya ebifo by'obulunzi mu mbeera enkalu.
person.lena-amupolo.voce: Ayogera mu ngeri ey'obumpi era entegeke, ku bigendererwa n'ebiseera.
person.lena-amupolo.background: Omukugu w'ensolo (zoologist) alina obumanyirivu obungi mu bifo by'obulunzi eby'e Afirika ey'obukiikaddyo.
person.jonas-tjivikua.ruolo: Omukugu w'obuzaale ow'okwetereeza mu mbeera enkalu · N.12
person.jonas-tjivikua.bio: Omukulira pulogulaamu y'obuzaale ey'okwetereeza mu mbeera enkalu n'ey'omunnyo ku N.12. Akola era akakasa enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale ezikwata ku kukuuma amazzi n'okugumira ebbugumu. Alabirira okulondoola omutindo gw'ebifaananyi n'okuwandiika ennyiriri.
person.jonas-tjivikua.voce: Alaga data n'obwegendereza obw'enkola, ng'awula ekiteeso ku kivaamu.
person.jonas-tjivikua.background: Omukugu w'obuzaale eyasomera wakati wa Namibia ne South Africa, eyeetongodde mu physiology y'okunyigirizibwa okw'obutonde.
person.selma-nghikembua.ruolo: Omukugu wa physiology y'okutereeza omunnyo · N.12
person.selma-nghikembua.bio: Asoma enkola z'okutereeza omunnyo n'obwenkanya bw'amazzi mu byewalula eby'omu ddungu ng'okutandika kwa N.12 kunaatera. Ateekawo enkola z'okupima ebisenge by'omunnyo n'okukuuma amazzi era afaayo okuzifuula ez'obulijjo. Akwataganya enkolagana wakati wa data za physiology n'pulogulaamu y'obuzaale.
person.selma-nghikembua.voce: Wa butuufu era wa nkola, yeesiga ebipimo nga tannaba kutuuka ku ndowooza.
person.selma-nghikembua.background: Omukugu wa physiology ey'okwenkanya alina PhD ku byetereeza by'amazzi eby'ebiramu ebyagala okukala.
person.petrus-haufiku.bio: Ayamba okuteekateeka terrari n'ebyuma bya N.12 mu kiseera ky'okuzimba. Afaayo ku kukuuma ebizimbe n'okutegeka ebitundu by'okulunda nga bwe kigobererwa enkola. Akwataganya wakati w'ebyetaago by'obulunzi n'abazimbi.
person.petrus-haufiku.voce: Wa mazima era wa butereevu, alaga embeera y'emirimu awatali kwetooloola.
person.petrus-haufiku.background: Omukozi w'obulunzi alina obumanyirivu obw'okukuuma ebyuma mu bifo by'omu ddungu.
person.rodrigo-fuentes.bio: Akulembera okuteekateeka Ekifo ky'Okunoonyereza N.13 mu Atacama, ekyeekuusa ku mbeera enkambwe, amasannyalaze ga UV n'obugulumivu obungi. Ateekawo ennoonyereza, ebyuma bya data n'enkolagana n'ebitongole by'obusayansi eby'ekitundu. Alina obumanyirivu mu kukwataganya pulogulaamu z'okunoonyereza mu mbeera enkambwe.
person.rodrigo-fuentes.voce: Wa nteekateeka era ateekateeka bulungi, alowooza ku bikulembezza eby'okunoonyereza n'obukoma bw'eby'obugagga.
person.rodrigo-fuentes.background: Omunoonyereza mu ecology y'embeera enkambwe alina obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya ebifo by'okunoonyereza.
person.camila-rojas.ruolo: Omunoonyereza ku masannyalaze ga UV n'ebiramu eby'omu mbeera enkambwe · N.13
person.camila-rojas.bio: Asoma enkola z'okugumira amasannyalaze ga UV n'engeri z'ebiramu ebibeera mu mbeera enkambwe (extremophiles) ng'okutandika kwa N.13 kunaatera. Ateekawo enkola z'okugezesa ku kwerinda ebbugumu n'okuddaabiriza DNA era afaayo ku kuzikakasa. Akwataganya enkolagana ne pulogulaamu z'obuzaale ez'omukutu.
person.camila-rojas.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa masso, akuuma nga byawuddwa ebivaamu ebisooka n'ebisembayo.
person.camila-rojas.background: Omukugu wa biology y'obutoffaali eyeetongodde mu byetereeza by'amasannyalaze ga UV.
person.matias-herrera.ruolo: Omukulira data n'okukola enkola z'oku ttale · N.13
person.matias-herrera.bio: Omukulira ebyuma bya data n'okukola enkola z'oku ttale eza N.13. Ateekateeka enkola z'okukuŋŋaanya n'okwekenneenya ebipimo by'obutonde era azimba enkola z'okuragula. Afaayo ku bujjuvu n'okusobola okugoberera data z'okunoonyereza.
person.matias-herrera.voce: Wa buwendo era wa bumpi, ayogera n'ebifaananyi (graphs) n'obukoma bw'obwesige.
person.matias-herrera.background: Nyinjiniya wa data alina obumanyirivu mu kulondoola obutonde n'okukola enkola z'oku ttale.
person.haruki-nakamura.bio: Akwataganya okuggalawo ekifo eky'oku lubalama eky'edda N.15 mu Okinawa n'okugatta emirimu ku N.7. Ateekateeka okuwaayo ensolo n'okukuuma ebizimbe nga bwe kigobererwa enkola. Afaayo ku bujjuvu bw'ebiwandiiko n'okusobola okugoberera CITES mu nkola yonna.
person.haruki-nakamura.voce: Wa nkola era wa bwegendereza, agenda ng'akozesa olukalala lw'okulondoola n'okukebera obumu ku bulala.
person.haruki-nakamura.background: Omukulira obulunzi alina obumanyirivu mu bifo by'oku lubalama eby'ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja.
person.yuki-tanaka.bio: Omusawo wa N.15, avunaanyizibwa obulamu bw'ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja mu kiseera ky'okugatta emirimu. Ateekateeka enteekateeka z'obulamu ez'okuwaayo era akebera obulamu nga bwe kigobererwa enkola. Awandiika okukebera obulamu n'ebipimo by'obulungi.
person.yuki-tanaka.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa mugaso, akakasa buli kisalwa eky'obusawo na data z'okukebera.
person.yuki-tanaka.background: Omusawo eyeetongodde mu biramu eby'omu nnyanja n'obujjanjabi bw'ensolo ez'omu maserene (aquarium).
person.kenji-shimabukuro.ruolo: Omukozi w'ebifo by'okulunda eby'omu nnyanja · N.15
person.kenji-shimabukuro.bio: Omukozi w'ebifo by'okulunda eby'omu nnyanja owa N.15, afaayo ku kuddukanya amasenero n'okulondoola ebipimo by'amazzi. Agoberera okutegeka ensolo eri emirimu gy'okuwaayo nga bwe kigobererwa enkola. Awandiika buli lunaku data z'obutonde n'ez'okukuuma.
person.kenji-shimabukuro.voce: Wa mazima era wa kwesigwa, alaga embeera y'amasenero n'obutuufu.
person.kenji-shimabukuro.background: Omukozi w'eby'omu maserene (aquarium) alina obumanyirivu obw'emyaka mingi mu byuma eby'oku lubalama.
person.andrea-ferrari.bio: Akulembera Ekifo N.16 mu Programma Sigma, ekyeekuusa ku kukakasa n'okugezesa mu nkola. Akwataganya emirimu nga bwe kigobererwa omutindo gw'obwama n'enkola z'okulabirira okw'enjawulo. Alaga butereevu eri Obukulembeze Obukulu.
person.andrea-ferrari.voce: Wa mugaso era yeekomako, ayogera ekyetaagisa awatali kwongera.
person.andrea-ferrari.background: Omukulembeze alina obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya pulogulaamu ez'okulabirira okw'enjawulo.
person.chiara-sartori.bio: Omukulira okukakasa n'okwerinda ku N.16. Ateekawo obulambulukufu bw'okugoberera n'okulondoola nga bwe kigobererwa enkola za Programma Sigma. Afaayo ku bujjuvu bw'ennyiriri n'okugoberera okuyingira okufugibwa.
person.chiara-sartori.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa nkola, tawa buwewufu obutawandiikiddwa.
person.chiara-sartori.background: Omukugu w'okwerinda n'okugoberera alina obumanyirivu mu bifo eby'okuyingira okukomeddwa.
person.joost-van-dijk.bio: Akulembera ekifo ky'ebyentambula ekya Rotterdam, avunaanyizibwa olunyiriri lw'okukuuma n'okukwataganya okuwaayo mu mukutu. Alabirira obujjuvu bw'ebiwandiiko n'okugoberera omutindo gwa CITES mu nkola yonna. Akwataganya enkolagana wakati w'ab'omu bulimba (customs), abatambuza n'ebifo bye biwaayo.
person.joost-van-dijk.voce: Wa butuufu era ateekateeka bulungi, alowooza ku nkulukuse n'ebifo by'okulondoola.
person.joost-van-dijk.background: Omukulira ebyentambula alina obumanyirivu mu kutambuza ebiramu okugobererwa amateeka.
person.marieke-de-vries.bio: Omusawo w'okwewala endwadde ku kifo ky'e Rotterdam, avunaanyizibwa okukebera obulamu mu kuyingira ne mu kufuluma. Ateekawo enkola z'okwawula era akebera obulamu bw'ensolo bw'okuwaayo. Awandiika ebivaamu eby'obusawo okuwagira okusobola okugoberera.
person.marieke-de-vries.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa masso, tawaayo lukusa okutuusa ng'akebedde obulamu.
person.marieke-de-vries.background: Omusawo eyeetongodde mu kwewala endwadde n'okukuuma obukuumi bw'obulamu bw'ensolo ez'enjawulo.
person.bram-hendriks.bio: Omukozi w'ebiwandiiko bya CITES ku kifo ky'e Rotterdam, addukanya olukusa, satifikeeti n'ennyiriri z'okuwaayo. Akebera obujjuvu n'obwenkanya bw'ebiwandiiko ebiwerekera buli kutambuza. Akuuma etterekero ery'okusobola okugoberera nga lya buggya.
person.bram-hendriks.voce: Wa bwegendereza era ateekateeka bulungi, alaga buli kigaana okuva ku nkola.
person.bram-hendriks.background: Omukozi w'obulambuzi omukugu mu mateeka g'obusuubuzi bw'ebika ebikuumibwa.
person.sarah-whitman.bio: Akulembera emirimu gy'amateeka olwa Amerika okuva mu Boston. Akwataganya enkolagana n'abakulira n'engeri y'okugoberera mu butale bw'ekitundu. Alabirira ebiwandiiko by'olukusa n'okukuuma omutindo ogugobererwa.
person.sarah-whitman.voce: Wa bulambulukufu era awakanya, azimba endowooza ku musingi gw'amateeka.
person.sarah-whitman.background: Omukugu w'emirimu gy'amateeka mu kitongole kya tekinologiya ey'obulamu mu bukiikakkono bwa Amerika.
person.david-kaplan.bio: Avunaanyizibwa obwannannyini bw'ebirowoozo n'ebikwata ku mateeka olwa Amerika. Addukanya paatente n'endagaano n'abakolagana n'ebitongole. Alabirira okukuuma ebintu by'ekkampuni n'okugoberera amateeka mu mirimu.
person.david-kaplan.voce: Wa butuufu era wa bwegendereza, apima ebigambo mu ngeri ey'endagaano.
person.david-kaplan.background: Munnamateeka eyeetongodde mu bwannannyini bw'ebirowoozo n'amateeka g'esayansi z'obulamu.
person.rachel-bennett.bio: Avunaanyizibwa enkolagana n'ebitongole olwa Amerika. Akulaakulanya enkolagana n'ebitongole by'okunoonyereza, amakolero n'ebitongole bya gavumenti. Afaayo ku kukwataganya endagaano n'okukiirira ekkampuni mu kitundu.
person.rachel-bennett.voce: Wa mukwano era ayolekera ekivaamu, azimba okukkiriziganya ku bigendererwa.
person.rachel-bennett.background: Omukugu w'enkolagana n'ebitongole alina obumanyirivu mu nkolagana z'obusayansi n'amakolero.
person.wei-lin-tan.bio: Akulembera okukwataganya ekitundu kya Asia-Pacific okuva mu Singapore. Alabirira emirimu gy'omukutu mu kitundu n'enkolagana n'abakolagana n'ebitongole eby'ekitundu. Agatta ebikulembezza eby'ekitundu ku ndagiriro y'Obukulembeze Obukulu.
person.wei-lin-tan.voce: Wa bwenkanya era mutabaganya, atabaganya wakati w'ebyetaago by'ekitundu n'endagiriro enkulu.
person.wei-lin-tan.background: Omukulembeze alina obumanyirivu mu kukwataganya emirimu gy'obusayansi mu kitundu kya Asia-Pacific.
person.priya-nair.bio: Avunaanyizibwa okugoberera n'enkolagana n'ebitongole olw'ekitundu kya APAC. Alabirira okugoberera amateeka g'ekitundu n'okuddukanya olukusa. Afaayo ku kukwatagana n'abakulira ab'amawanga ag'enjawulo ag'ekitundu.
person.priya-nair.voce: Wa butuufu era wa mpisa, azza buli mulimu ku musingi gw'amateeka.
person.priya-nair.background: Omukugu w'okugoberera alina obumanyirivu mu mateeka g'obutale bwa Asia.
person.aoife-byrne.bio: Akulembera okuteekateeka n'okutandika ekyuma ky'okugezesa eky'okukola ebintu eby'obulamu ekya Cork, ekyeekuusa ku kwongera obunene bw'ebikozesebwa n'ebintu. Akwataganya okuteeka enkola z'okukola n'okuva ku kigero kya laabu okutuuka ku ky'okugezesa. Alina obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya ebyuma bya tekinologiya ey'obulamu.
person.aoife-byrne.voce: Wa mazima era ateekateeka, alowooza ku bivaamu, ebiseera n'obukoma bw'enkola.
person.aoife-byrne.background: Omukugu wa tekinologiya ey'obulamu alina obumanyirivu mu kuddukanya ebyuma by'okugezesa eby'okukola ebintu eby'obulamu.
person.liam-osullivan.bio: Nyinjiniya w'enkola ku kyuma ky'okugezesa ekya Cork, avunaanyizibwa okwongera obunene bw'enkola z'obulamu. Ateekateeka era alongoosa emitendera gy'okuggya (fermentation n'recovery) olw'okudda ku kigero ky'okugezesa. Ateekawo ebipimo by'enkola era afaayo ku kubikakasa.
person.liam-osullivan.voce: Wa kwekenneenya era wa nkola, alowooza ku bwenkanya bw'obuzito n'ebipimo ebikulu.
person.liam-osullivan.background: Nyinjiniya wa kemikaali eyeetongodde mu nkola z'obulamu n'okuwaayo tekinologiya.
person.niamh-doyle.ruolo: Omukugu wa kemikaali w'ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu · BIOPROD
person.niamh-doyle.bio: Avunaanyizibwa okwekenneenya kemikaali ku bikozesebwa eby'obulamu ku kyuma ky'okugezesa eky'e Cork. Ateekawo enkola z'okwekenneenya n'obulambulukufu bw'omutindo gw'ebintu ebikolebwa. Akwataganya enkolagana wakati w'okukola ebintu n'enkola z'okukola.
person.niamh-doyle.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa butuufu, takakasa kikozesebwa awatali data z'okwekenneenya ezijjuvu.
person.niamh-doyle.background: Omukugu wa kemikaali y'ebikozesebwa alina obumanyirivu mu kukola ebikozesebwa eby'obulamu ebikozesebwa.
person.cian-murphy.bio: Avunaanyizibwa omutindo n'okugoberera okw'ekyuma ky'okugezesa eky'e Cork. Ateekawo enkola y'okuddukanya omutindo era alabirira okugoberera enkola ennungi ez'okukola. Afaayo ku kuwandiika enkola n'okukebera okw'omunda (internal audits).
person.cian-murphy.voce: Wa bwegendereza era wa nteekateeka, akebera okugoberera nga tannaba kufulumya kintu kyonna.
person.cian-murphy.background: Omukugu w'omutindo n'okugoberera mu kitongole ky'okukola ebintu eby'obulamu.
person.erik-sorensen.bio: Akulembera etterekero ery'okwerondako ery'e Svalbard, eryeekuusa ku kukuuma okw'obukuumi n'okuzzaawo data za bayobanka. Ateekawo enkola z'okwerondako n'enkola z'okuzzaawo data. Alabirira obujjuvu n'okubaawo kw'amaterekero mu kiseera ekiwanvu.
person.erik-sorensen.voce: Wa nkola era wa masso, alowooza ku mbeera z'okwonooneka n'okuzzaawo.
person.erik-sorensen.background: Omukugu w'okuddukanya data alina obumanyirivu mu materekero g'obukuumi ag'ekiseera ekiwanvu.
person.ingrid-halvorsen.ruolo: Omukozi w'okukuuma mu bunnyogovu n'ebyuma bya data · ARCH
person.ingrid-halvorsen.bio: Omukozi w'etterekero ery'e Svalbard, afaayo ku kukuuma ebyokulabirako mu bunnyogovu n'okuddukanya ebyuma bya data. Alondoola ebipimo by'okukuuma n'okukuuma enkola z'okutereka. Awandiika era akebera emirimu gy'okukoppa n'okuzzaawo (backup n'restore).
person.ingrid-halvorsen.voce: Wa butuufu era wa kwesigwa, alondoola buli kipimo eky'okukuuma.
person.ingrid-halvorsen.background: Omukozi wa laabu alina obumanyirivu mu kukuuma mu bunnyogovu n'enkola z'okutereka data.
person.paulo-ribeiro.bio: Akulembera sitensoni ey'oku ttale ey'e Manaus, eyeekuusa ku kukuŋŋaanya n'okusoma ennyiriri ez'omu nsiko mu Amazzoni. Akwataganya olugendo lw'oku ttale, olukusa lw'okukuŋŋaanya n'enkolagana n'ebitongole eby'ekitundu. Alabirira okusobola okugoberera ebyokulabirako nga bwe kigobererwa omutindo gwa CITES.
person.paulo-ribeiro.voce: Wa mazima era wa masso, akyusa enteekateeka okusinziira ku mbeera y'oku ttale.
person.paulo-ribeiro.background: Omukugu wa biology ow'oku ttale alina obumanyirivu obungi mu Amazzoni n'okuddukanya sitensoni z'okunoonyereza.

person.beatriz-alves.bio: Omukugu wa biology ow'oku ttale owa sitensoni ey'e Manaus, afaayo ku kukuŋŋaanya, okulondoola n'okwekenneenya okwasooka okw'ennyiriri ez'omu nsiko. Afaayo ku kulunda okw'ekiseera ebyokulabirako n'okuwandiika data z'oku ttale. Awagira ebyentambula by'olugendo n'okukuuma ebikozesebwa.
