specimen.47B.note: Ensolo ey'okwesigamako eya pulogulaamu y'Amagezi & Enneeyisa (Protocollo B). Eri mu kunoonyerezebwa okw'enneeyisa okuwanvu ku Villa Monti olw'ebiddirira ebimu ebitali bya bulijjo, ebikyali mu kukakasibwa era ebitannazzeemu mu ngeri efugibwa.
specimen.41C.note: Ekigezo eky'okukebera olw'okuwulira ekya Protocollo C: okwongera okulaba kwa UV n'okuwunyiriza okwa vomeronasal, n'enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ekika.
specimen.49B.note: Ekifundo kimu eky'enkyukakyuka eza Protocollo B (B-ATC) nga 47B; enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ekika. Ekozesebwa ng'ekikebero eky'enkola.
specimen.37B.note: Ekipimo eky'edda eky'omulembe ogw'okusatu, enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ekika. Ekigero eky'olubereberye lwa Protocollo B.
specimen.26B.note: Ensolo ey'omulembe ogw'okubiri erina okwetegereza kw'enneeyisa okutali kukakafu era okutaali kuzzeemu; yafa nga tennakebebwa. Ebintu byayo biterekeddwa mu bayobanka (N.1).
specimen.53D.note: Ensolo ey'omulembe ogw'okutaano (Protocollo D) eyalabika ng'etetuukira ku bulunzi obwa bulijjo era eyaweebwayo; olunyiriri lwa CITES terujjuvu olw'ensobi mu biwandiiko.
specimen.94G.note: Ensajja esinga amaanyi mu kibinja, erina omubiri omunene n'okukwataganya okungi mu kibinja. Ekigero kya Protocollo G.
specimen.91F.note: Ensolo ey'obuteesa eya Protocollo F (okuwummula kw'omubiri), erina otulo olufugibwa olunywevu ennyo.
specimen.88G.note: Ensolo ey'obunene obw'ekitalo, erina amagumba amazito n'obugumu. Ewulira bulungi mu kuduumirwa.
specimen.96G.note: Enkazi ento ey'obunene obutono era ey'embiro nnyo; enneeyisa ey'okunoonya ekyali mu kusomebwa.
specimen.85F.note: Protocollo F (okuwummula kw'omubiri), erina okugumira obunnyogovu obungi.
specimen.89G.note: Ensolo enkulu ey'omulwanyi ow'edda ow'ekibinja, erina ebipimo by'ebinywa n'amagumba eby'okwesigamako.
specimen.11C.note: Olunyiriri olusooka olw'obunnabbubi obusala olulina obukalu obw'amaaso amakulu obwongeddwa okutuuka ku UV eya kumpi. Yawula ebifaananyi by'okumasamasa ku muyiggo ogutali gutambula ku bbanga eriwera emirundi ebiri okusinga olunyiriri olw'omu nsiko. Ekigero eky'okuwulira ekya cohorte C.
specimen.12D.note: Emolinfa (hemolymph) ejjuzibbwa peptides eziziyiza obuwuka obutono ekendeeza ku kufa okuva ku bulwadde bwa ffene (fungal) mu buggya. Ewona okwolekagana n'ensigo za Ophiocordyceps ezitta mu bikebero.
specimen.21C.note: Obungi obwongeddwa obwa fotorecettori mu retina ey'ebibinja. Yawula bulungi langi mu kiragala-kimyufu, ekigasa mu kwekenneenya okuwaayo kw'enneeyisa ey'okuwulira wakati w'ennyiriri.
specimen.22D.note: Olunyiriri olw'okukebera olw'okugumira nematodi ezitta obuwuka; okuddamu kw'obukuumi bw'omubiri okwa bwangu naye okuzaala kutali kukyuseemu.
specimen.31C.note: Ensolo ey'ekitalo olw'obusobozi obw'amaanyi obw'okuzuula okutambula. Tewali kabonero ka nkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa okusukka ku by'obuyiggo obwa bulijjo obw'obunnabbubi obusala.
specimen.32D.note: Cohorte eyateesebwa okugatta okugumira ffene n'obuwuka mu ngeri emu ey'obutoffaali bw'omusaayi. Eri mu kwekenneenya olw'obunywevu bw'engeri wakati w'okuwaguza olususu.
specimen.11B.note: Olunyiriri olw'omusingi olulina okuzzaawo amagulu okwa bwangu n'okugumira ebbugumu okutuuka ku 24 °C awatali kufiirwa neoteny. Okuwonya olususu awatali fibrosis ne ku bbugumu erya waggulu.
specimen.12G.note: Okukola blastema okwa bwangu 30% oluvannyuma lw'okusala okugulu okw'omu maaso. Ensolo ey'okwesigamako olw'okukwata ebifaananyi eby'okuwanvu eby'okuzzaawo.
specimen.21B.note: Okuzzaawo olususu olulina langi: ebifaananyi bya langi biddamu okukolebwa mu butuufu oluvannyuma lw'okulumizibwa. Kigasa okusoma okuzzaawo ebifaananyi bya melanophores.
specimen.22G.note: Yalondebwa olw'okuzzaawo ebinywa by'omutima oluvannyuma lw'okulumizibwa okufugibwa okw'ekisenge, wamu n'okuzzaawo amagulu. Ekyokulabirako eky'okuddaabiriza omutima awatali kubalagala.
specimen.31B.note: Neoteny enywevu ku mirembe esatu n'okuziyiza metamorphosis mu ngeri ey'obwesige. Egatta okuzzaawo n'okugumira ebbugumu; ekisembayo eky'okuwaayo mu bunnyogovu eri N1.
specimen.32G.note: Ekigero eky'ebinywa n'amagumba: okuzzaawo obugulumba obw'engalo obungi mu lunyiriri awatali bukyamu. Enjawulo ntono wakati w'ensolo emu n'endala.
specimen.13B.note: Ekitundu ky'iguana eky'omulembe omutono ekirina okufuga ebbugumu mu nneeyisa okulungi ennyo n'okukyusa langi ku mugongo okw'amaanyi. Enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ekika.
specimen.14C.note: Eriiso ery'oku mutwe (parietal) erisinga okuwulira n'okwawula obulungi ekitangaala ekitereerezebwa, ekigasa mu kwetereeza. Enneeyisa eya bulijjo ey'ekika.
specimen.23B.note: Okuwonya ebiwundu by'olususu okwa bwangu n'okufiirwa ebbugumu okutono ekiro. Enkola y'omubiri esingira ddala okutuukira ku mbeera y'ebifo eby'e Itaali eby'ebbugumu.
specimen.24C.note: Okulaba langi okwongeddwa n'okuddamu okusinga ku bubonero obw'omu bulago (gular) obw'ekika kyayo. Enkolagana z'obwenkanya ez'amaanyi naye awatali bubonero bwa kwemanya.
specimen.51B.note: Olunyiriri olw'omu maaso olumpi ku kitundu 47B; ebiddirira ebitali bikakafu eby'okwolekera endabirwamu ekiseera ekiwanvu, ebitaali bizzeemu mu ngeri efugibwa. Akabonero k'enneeyisa akatannategeerekeka, kalinda okukakasibwa.
specimen.52C.note: Maapu y'okuwulira egatta okulaba n'okuwunyiriza naye tewali nkyukakyuka ya magezi eyazuulibwa. Ekozesebwa ng'ekikebero ekibi eri ennyiriri eziriko enneeyisa etali ya bulijjo.
specimen.13D.note: Elapide ey'omusingi erina okugumira endwadde z'okussa okuva ku mycobacteria okwongeddwa. Omutindo gw'obukuumi bw'omubiri ogw'ekigero ogwa waggulu awatali kukyusa embeera y'obusagwa.
specimen.14F.note: Yalondebwa olw'okugumira okubulwa oxygen mu kiseera ky'okuwummula okuwanvu; ewona ebiseera ebiwanvu eby'oxygen entono nga fibrosis mu bitundu ekendedde.
specimen.23D.note: Okuggyawo obuwuka obw'omu byenda okwa bwangu. Okukula okwa bulijjo n'okuzaala okunywevu, ekituufu olw'okwongera ku kibinja.
specimen.24F.note: Okukuba kw'omutima mu kuwummula kuyinza okussibwa wansi mu ngeri eddibwamu ku kiragiro ky'ebbugumu, n'okuddamu okwa bwongo okujjuvu ku kuzuukuka. Ekigero olw'enkola z'okutambuza.
specimen.33D.note: Ekigero eky'obukuumi bw'omubiri eky'ebibinja ebingi ebya peptides eziziyiza obuwuka mu lususu. Ekozesebwa okugera ebigezo by'okugumira obuwuka.
specimen.34F.note: Cohorte eyateesebwa okugatta okugumira okubulwa oxygen n'okukendeeza ebyetaago by'omubiri mu biseera by'obutiti. Eri mu kwekenneenya olw'ebikwata ku kuzaala.
specimen.71G.note: Pulogulaamu y'enswaswa ekulaakulanye: okuzzaawo omukira ekitundu n'okuzzaawo amagumba g'omugongo, si cartilage yokka. Ebinywa by'amagulu bisukka ku kigero.
specimen.72F.note: Okugumira okubulwa oxygen mu kunnyika okuwanvu n'okukendeera kw'omutima mu kunnyika okw'amaanyi. Obutereke bwa myoglobin buli waggulu.
specimen.81G.note: Okuwonya amagumba amamenyefu okwa bwangu n'okuzzaawo amagumba amazito. Ekisembayo eky'okuwaayo eri N10 nga asset ey'okukakasa ebinywa n'amagumba.
specimen.82F.note: Yaweebwayo olw'okuwummula kw'omubiri okufugibwa okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu n'okuddamu okujjuvu okw'ekibumba. Ebiwandiiko by'okuwaayo byagabanyizibwa n'ekifo ky'okukakasa.
specimen.92G.note: Emirundi egimu egy'enneeyisa ey'okugonjoola ebizibu mu kuggya emmere, etegeerekeka bulungi okuva ku kuyiga okw'okugatta. Akabonero k'enneeyisa akatannategeerekeka.
specimen.93F.note: Okuwummula okusinga obulungi mu pulogulaamu y'e Polandi: okukozesa amaanyi okutono mu kuwummula okw'ebiseara awatali kufiirwa binywa kupimibwa.
specimen.11E.note: Olunyiriri olw'omusingi olulina ebisenge by'omunnyo ebisingako obulungi ebiri waggulu w'amaaso, ebisobozesa obwenkanya bw'amazzi obunywevu mu munnyo omungi.
specimen.12H.note: Obubonero bw'obukadde bw'obutoffaali obukendedde n'okukuuma telomeres okuwanvu. Okukula okwa mpola naye okw'olubeerera ng'okw'enfudu ez'obuwangaazi.
specimen.21E.note: Idrofide erina ekisenge ky'omunnyo ekiri wansi w'olulimi ekyongeddwa n'okuyingiza oxygen mu lususu okulongoosebbwa. Obwenkanya bw'omunnyo obunywevu mu mazzi g'ennyanja amajjuvu.
specimen.22H.note: Ekigero eky'obuwangaazi eky'obwononefu obutono obw'ebitundu n'okuddaabiriza cartilage ey'ennyingo okulungi.
specimen.31E.note: Cohorte eyateesebwa okugatta okutereeza omunnyo okunywevu n'okugumira enkyukakyuka ez'amangu ez'omunnyo mu bitundu wamu awagattira emyala n'ennyanja. Elinda okwekenneenya kw'ensigo (renal function).
specimen.15B.note: Olunyiriri olw'omusingi olulina okufuga okulungi ennyo kwa nanocrystals za guanina mu iridofori, ekyongera ekigero ky'okukyusa langi. Okukyusa langi okwa bwangu.
specimen.16C.note: Okukwataganya kw'amaaso okw'obwannannyini okwongeddwa n'okupima obulungi ebbanga olw'okusuula olulimi. Obutuufu obw'okukwata omuyiggo obusinga olunyiriri olw'omu nsiko.
specimen.25B.note: Okuwa obubonero obwa langi obw'obwenkanya obunywevu n'okuggyawo ebbugumu okulungi olw'okumasamasa okukyuka. Enneeyisa ey'okukuuma ekitundu eya bulijjo.
specimen.26C.note: Ekigero eky'okuwulira ekirina eddaala ery'okulaba eryagaziyiziddwa n'ekiseera ekitono eky'okuddamu ku bintu ebitambula.
specimen.35B.note: Okufuga ebbugumu okwa langi okwatuukirizibwa olw'embeera y'ebifo eby'e Uganda. Okuwonya olususu okwa bwangu n'okuzzaawo ebifaananyi bya langi mu butuufu.
specimen.17C.note: Namuŋŋoona ey'omusingi erina okulaba n'okukwataganya eriiso n'akamwa okwongeddwa olw'okukozesa ebikozesebwa. Obusobozi bw'amagezi obwa waggulu naye obuli mu by'obuyiga obumanyiddwa obw'ekika eky'omu nsiko.
specimen.18H.note: Olunyiriri olw'obuwangaazi obungi olulina okukaddiwa kw'obukuumi bw'omubiri okutono. Ebyoya n'ekibumba binywevu mu kulondoola okw'emyaka mingi.
specimen.27C.note: Okwawula okusingako obulungi okw'okuwulira amaloboozi ag'ekika kyayo. Okuyiga okw'obwenkanya okwa bulijjo; tewali kabonero ka kwemanya.
specimen.28H.note: Ekigero eky'obuwangaazi eky'obubonero bw'okunyigirizibwa okw'obutoffaali obukendeeddwa n'okuddaabiriza telomeres okulungi.
specimen.46H.note: Olunyiriri lw'iguana olw'edda olw'omulembe ogw'okuna, oluterekeddwa mu bunnyogovu ng'ekigero eky'oluberyeberye lwa 47B olw'enkola y'obuwangaazi.
specimen.87A.note: Olunyiriri lw'enswaswa oluterekeddwa olw'obulamu obw'amagi obungi n'okufa okutono okw'obwana. Ebintu eby'okutandika olw'okuzzaawo olunyiriri.
specimen.19A.note: Olunyiriri olusooka olwa nnabbubi oluterekeddwa mu bunnyogovu olw'okukakasa enkola z'okukuuma emolinfa (hemolymph) mu bunnabbubi.
specimen.63H.note: Olunyiriri lw'enswaswa olw'omulembe ogw'omukaaga oluterekeddwa ng'ekigero eky'obuwangaazi ekyakulembera ennyiriri ez'omu maaso.
specimen.74G.note: Asset eyaweebwayo okuva N6 era eyakakasibwa mu Amerika olw'okuzzaawo ebinywa n'amagumba okuddibwamu. Okuzzaawo amagumba n'okuddamu okw'emirimu kwakakasibwa mu ngeri ey'obwannguddwa.
specimen.86F.note: Ensolo eyakakasibwa olw'okuwummula kw'omubiri okufugibwa, eyaweebwayo okuva mu pulogulaamu y'e Polandi. Ebipimo by'okuwummula n'okuddamu byazzibwamu mu bukoma.

generation.4.testo: Ekibinja ky'okwesigamako ekya pulogulaamu y'iguana. Okusoma amagezi n'enneeyisa kiri mu maaso.
generation.5.testo: Omulembe ogw'ekiseera kimu ne 4; gulimu ensolo ezitatuukira ku bulunzi obwa bulijjo era ezaddirira okuweebwayo.
generation.8.testo: Olunyiriri olusooka olunywevu olwa Laabu N.6 (Polandi).

glossary.0.definizione: Okufuga ebbugumu ery'omubiri nga bwesigamye ku nsibuko ez'ebweru. Engeri ey'omusingi ey'ebyewalula, omusingi gwa Protocollo B.
glossary.1.definizione: Obutoffaali obulina langi obuvunaanyizibwa okukyusa langi; obwongeddwa mu Protocollo B.
glossary.2.definizione: Obusobozi bw'okwesuula n'okuzzaawo omukira; omusingi gwa Protocolli B ne G.
glossary.3.definizione: Obuzaale obwenyigira mu nkula y'obwongo n'okusobola okukyuka. Bukuumibwa mu byewalula n'ebiyonsa (vertebrates).
glossary.4.definizione: Obuzaale obw'obutoffaali obw'obwongo obuzaala (neural stem cells); obw'omu makkati mu kwongera okwa Protocollo B.
glossary.5.definizione: Ekizimbe eky'okuwunyiriza eky'okuyamba; ekyongeddwa mu Protocollo C.
glossary.6.definizione: Okuwulira amasannyalaze ga UV, okwagaziyiziddwa mu Protocollo C.
glossary.7.definizione: Okwalula okukwatagana okwa cohorte; akabonero k'obunywevu bwa pulogulaamu.
glossary.8.definizione: Okuggya n'okuzza obuggya olususu olw'ebweru ku biseera.
glossary.9.definizione: Okufuluma kw'ebbugumu okutafugibwa mu kukolagana: obulabe obuva ku kukwata reagents ezikwatibwako ennyo.
experiment.exp-n1-crio-vetrificazione-ge: Okukuuma ensibuko z'obuzaale z'ebyewalula mu bunnyogovu (vitrification)
Okukuuma ekiseera ekiwanvu amagi (ovociti) n'ebitundu by'okuzaala eby'ebika ebiri mu kabi awatali kukola kristaalo za nnyonta.
Vitrification n'ebikuuma obunnyogovu ebiyingira (ethylene glycol/DMSO) n'okunnyogeza okwa bwangu ennyo mu nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu ku -196 dditiigulu.
Obulamu oluvannyuma lw'okunnyogolwa bwa 71% ku magi ga iguana, nga wakyaliyo obwonoonefu obwa mitochondria obw'okukendeeza.

Embeera: Okukuuma ekiseera ekiwanvu ensigo z'ebyewalula ebiri mu kabi kyetaagisa enkola eziziyiza okukola kwa nnyonta munda mu butoffaali, ekisookera ddala okuvaako obwonoonefu mu kunnyogeza. Enkola: Amagi (ovociti) n'obutundu bw'ebitundu by'okuzaala obwa iguana byakolebwako vitrification nga bikozesa ebikuuma obunnyogovu ebiyingira ebigattiddwa (ethylene glycol ne DMSO) mu bungi obungi, n'okunnyogeza okwa bwangu ennyo nga binnyikibwa butereevu mu nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu ku -196°C n'okuddamu okwokebwa okwa bwangu okufugibwa. Obulamu oluvannyuma lw'okunnyogolwa bwapimibwa n'ebigezo by'obujjuvu bw'olususu lw'obutoffaali, embeera ya mitochondria n'okuddamu okw'enkola y'omubiri. Ebivaamu: 71% ku magi baakuuma obulungi bwago n'obujjuvu bw'olususu; kyokka ekitundu ekinene kyalaga okunafuwa kwa mitochondria n'okukola okungi kwa ROS (reactive oxygen species), ekiraga okunyigirizibwa okw'oxygen okutaali kuziyizibwa kwenkanankana. Okumaliriza: Vitrification esobozesa okukuuma mu bunnyogovu awatali nnyonta okulungi eri ensibuko z'obuzaale z'ebyewalula, naye okukendeeza obwonoonefu bwa mitochondria kyetaagisa okulongoosa emitendera gy'ebbugumu n'okuyingiza antioxidants mu bikuuma obunnyogovu.
experiment.exp-n1-archivio-referenza-gen: Okuzimba bbanka y'obuzaale obw'okwesigamako obugabanibwa wakati w'ebifo byonna okulondoola ennyiriri ezongeddwa.
Okusoma obuzaale okw'ebisale ebiwanvu (Oxford Nanopore) n'okugatta de novo n'okuwandiika ebyokulabirako mu ngeri ekuumibwa (crittografica).
Byateekebwa obuzaale 214 obuwandiike; ennyiriri ezimu eza N6 zirina enkyukakyuka ezitali mu rejjisita ez'ensibuko.

Embeera: Okulondoola ennyiriri ezongeddwa wakati w'ebifo kyetaagisa obuzaale obw'okwesigamako obujjuvu era obukebereka. Enkola: Twasoma obuzaale 214 obw'ebika bingi n'tekinologiya ya Oxford Nanopore ey'ebisale ebiwanvu, ne tukola okugatta de novo (okuzuula n'okutereeza overlaps, okugatta n'okulongoosa consensus) n'okuwandiika ensengeka n'emirimu; buli buzaale bwawandiikibwa n'hashes eza crittografia okukakasa obujjuvu n'obutakaanya ebyateekebwa. Ebivaamu: Byateekebwa obuzaale 214 obuwandiike obulina okugendera mu maaso ku ddaala lya chromosomes. Okugeraageranya kwalaga mu nnyiriri ezimu ez'ekifo N6 enkyukakyuka ez'ensengeka n'ez'obuzaale obw'omu makkati ezitaali mu rejjisita ez'ensibuko, ezikwatagana n'ebyaliwo eby'okukyusa oba okugatta obutaali buwandiike. Okumaliriza: Etterekero liwa ekigero ekigabanibwa era ekitakyusibwa olw'okulondoola obuzaale; enjawulo ezaazuulibwa mu nnyiriri za N6 zeetaaga okukebereka n'olunyiriri lw'okukuuma ne rejjisita z'okugezesa.
experiment.exp-n1-stabilita-dna-decennal: Obunywevu bwa DNA mu kutereka okw'emyaka kkumi
Okupima okwonoonebwa kwa DNA eterekeddwa okuteekawo emitendera gy'okuddamu okukebera ebyokulabirako.
Okugeraageranya okumenyeka nga bakozesa electrophoresis y'omuguwa ku bitundu ebiterekeddwa ku -80 dditiigulu ng'ogeraageranya ne nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu ku biseera.
Nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu akendeeza okumenyeka 40% ku myaka kkumi; -80 dditiigulu batuukirira wansi w'emyaka etaano zokka.

Embeera: Okuteekawo emitendera gy'okuddamu okukebera ebyokulabirako ebiterekeddwa kyetaagisa okupima okwonoonebwa kwa DNA nga bwe kutuukira ku bbugumu ery'okutereka. Enkola: Ebitundu bya DNA byaterekebwa awamu ku -80°C ne mu nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu; ku biseera ebiteekebwateekebwa okumenyeka kwapimibwa ne electrophoresis y'omuguwa, nga babalirira ebipimo by'obujjuvu n'emitendera gy'okumenyeka okusinziira ku nkola ya Arrhenius. Ebivaamu: Ku myaka kkumi, ebyokulabirako ebyali mu nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu byalaga okumenyeka okukendeezeddwa 40% okusinga ebyali ku -80°C. Okutereka ku -80°C kwatuukirira mu myaka etaano, oluvannyuma lwa gino okumenyeka kusukka ku bipimo ebikkirizibwa olw'enkozesa ez'oluvannyuma. Okumaliriza: Olw'okutereka okw'emyaka kkumi n'okusukka waggulu, nitrogen ali mu bunnyogovu kye kirungi; olw'ebyokulabirako ebya -80°C, emitendera gy'okuddamu okukebera n'okuzza obuggya buli myaka etaano gyateekebwawo.
experiment.exp-n1-catena-custodia-campio: Okukakasa obujjuvu n'obutakaanya mu kutambuza ebintu eby'obulamu wakati w'ebifo.
Enkola y'okuwandiika ku rejjisita eyongerwako yokka (append-only) n'omukono gw'ebiseera n'okukakasa n'ebisumuluzo bibiri ku kutuusa.
Yatandikibwawo mu kukola; ebitakwatagana bibiri eby'ensibuko eby'edda byalagibwa era biri mu kunnyonnyolwa ne N9.

Embeera: Okutambuza ebintu eby'obulamu wakati w'ebifo kyetaagisa obukakafu bw'obujjuvu n'obutakaanya. Enkola: Twateekawo enkola y'okuwandiika esinziira ku rejjisita eyongerwako yokka (append-only), nga buli kyaliwo eky'okukuuma kigattibwa ku ky'emabega n'hashes eza crittografia n'omukono gw'ebiseera, n'okukakasa n'ebisumuluzo bibiri ku kutuusa. Obujjuvu bw'olunyiriri bukakasibwa olw'obutasoboka kw'okuddayo emabega oba okukyusa ebyawandiikibwa awatali kwonoona olunyiriri. Ebivaamu: Enkola yateekebwawo mu kukola ku kutambuza kwonna; okugeraageranya okw'obwannguddwa wakati w'ensibuko eyalangibwa ne rejjisita kwaleeta ebitakwatagana bibiri eby'ensibuko eby'edda, ebiri kaakati mu kunnyonnyolwa awamu n'ekifo N9. Okumaliriza: Okukozesa rejjisita etakyusibwa erina omukono gw'ebiseera kinyweza okusobola okulondoola era kisobozesa okuzuula obutali bwa bulijjo emabega; okugatta ku tterekero ly'obuzaale kisobozesa okukakasa obwesimbu bw'ebyokulabirako.
experiment.exp-n2-visione-composita.tito: Okukola maapu y'okulaba okugatte okwa nnabbubi abasala
experiment.exp-n2-visione-composita.obie: Okutegeera engeri nnabbubi abasala gye bagatta amaaso munaana okuba okulaba kumu okulungi.
experiment.exp-n2-visione-composita.meto: Microscopy ne electroretinography n'ebisikiriza ebitambula mu kifo, nga balondoola okuddamu kw'amaaso amakulu.
experiment.exp-n2-visione-composita.risu: Kwazuulibwa okukebera kwa retina okukola, okuddamu okuzimba embeera olulyo ku lulyo, si kifaananyi kimu ekitali kitambula.
experiment.exp-n2-visione-composita.abst: Embeera: Nnabbubi abasala (Salticidae) balina okulaba okw'ekitalo olw'obunene bwabwe, okuyita mu maaso ag'omu maaso ag'omu makkati (amakulu), retina yaago ey'ekika kya boomerang etegekeddwa mu maddaala ana ag'obutoffaali obulaba nga buweerezebwa omulanga omuwanvu ogutambula. Engeri ensengeka eno, etaliiko fovea ey'ekifo ekigazi, gy'ekola okulaba okumu tekyategeerekeka bulungi. Enkola: Twagatta microscopy y'omulanga gw'eriiso, electroretinography y'amaaso amakulu n'okulaga ebisikiriza ebitambula mu kifo, nga tuwandiika okuddamu kw'amaaso okuva ku binywa by'retina nga balondoola omuyiggo. Ebivaamu: Ebyawandiikibwa bilaga okukebera kwa retina okukola: retina enkulu ekebera embeera ku biseera n'okutambula okuzinga n'okwa bbali-makkati, nga ekebera olulyo ku lulyo ebitundu ebiriraanagana eby'ekifo eky'okulaba mu kifo ky'okukwata ekifaananyi kimu ekitali kitambula. Okugatta kw'ebiseera kw'ebikebero bino, nga buyambibwa amaaso ag'omu mabbali agazuula okutambula, kuzimba okulaba okulungi. Okumaliriza: Okulaba kwa nnabbubi abasala mulimu ogukola era ogugenda mu lunyiriri, embeera kw'egattibwa ku biseera, si ekwatibwa mu kaseera kamu, ekyokulabirako eky'obwenkanya era ekikwatagana n'ensengeka ya retina ey'amaddaala.
experiment.exp-n2-seta-dragline-ricombin: Okwongera amaanyi g'okusika ag'obwoya obw'obukuumi nga bukyuunza.
Okukola spidroins mu nnyiriri z'obutoffaali (recombinant) n'okwekenneenya amaanyi n'nanoindentation.
Obuwuzi obulina amaanyi agasukka 18% ku lunyiriri olw'omu nsiko, naye okuluka kukyali kutanywevu ku bunene.

Embeera: Obwoya bwa dragline obwa nnabbubi buggya amaanyi gaabwo amangi ku spidroins ennene (MaSp1, MaSp2), puloteyina ez'okuddiŋŋanako eziriko ebitundu bya poly-alanine ebya kristaalo n'ebitundu ebijjudde glycine ebitali bya kristaalo. Okuddamu okukola mu ngeri ya recombinant obuwuzi obulina obwenkanya obw'obutonde wakati w'amaanyi g'okusika n'okukyuunza kikyali kisoomooza mu tekinologiya ey'obulamu. Enkola: Twakola spidroins ez'obuzito obungi mu nnyiriri z'obutoffaali ez'ebweru, ne tulongoosa puloteyina ne tukola obuwuzi n'okuluka mu mazzi; amaanyi gaabwo gaapimibwa n'ebigezo by'okusika ne nanoindentation, nga tugigatta ku bungi bwa beta-sheets obwapimibwa. Ebivaamu: Obuwuzi obwalongoosebwa bulaga amaanyi agasukka 18% ku lunyiriri olw'omu nsiko, nga bukyuunza kyenkanankana olw'okwongera ekitundu kya kristaalo ekitereezeddwa. Kyokka enkola y'okuluka ekyali etanywevu ku bunene, n'enjawulo mu bugazi n'obukyamu ebikoma obweddibwamu. Okumaliriza: Okukola ebitundu eby'enkomerero n'embeera z'okuluka kyongera amaanyi awatali kufiirwa okukyuunza, naye okufuga self-assembly kikyali ekiziyiza okukola okw'amakolero.
experiment.exp-n2-rete-sensoriale-distri: Okuwulira okusaasaanye okuyita mu kunyeenya kw'obutimba
Okutegeera engeri obutimba gye bugaziya okuwulira kwa nnabbubi okusukka ku mubiri nga butambuza amawulire ag'okunyeenya.
Vibrometry ya laser Doppler ku butimba n'ensibuko ezifugibwa n'okwekenneenya kw'okuddamu okw'obuyiggo.
Obutimba bukola nga akakengera ak'omubiri akatereezeddwa akalongoosa obubonero nga tebunnatuuka ku nsolo.

Embeera: Nnabbubi bangi bawulira omuyiggo okusinga nga bayita mu kunyeenya okutambuzibwa obutimba obw'obwoya. Obutimba si kkubo eritakola naye kizimbe ekikola ekitereezeka ekisengejja era ekitambuza obubonero nga tebunnatuuka ku bawulira (sensilli a fessura) ab'amagulu, nga bugaziya okuwulira okusukka ku mubiri gw'ensolo. Enkola: Nga tukozesa vibrometry ya laser Doppler twapima okutambuza kw'ebisikiriza ebifugibwa ebiteekebwa mu butimba, nga tugeraageranya amayengo ag'oku bbali n'ag'obuwanvu ku bipimo bingi eby'okukuba, era nga tugatta okuddamu kw'obuyiggo ku kwekenneenya kw'obubonero obutuuka ku nsolo. Ebivaamu: Obutimba bukola nga akakengera ak'omubiri akatereezeddwa: ebitundu eby'obuwanvu bitambula n'okunafuwa okutono era bikuuma amawulire ag'ekkubo agasingako, so ng'okusika kw'obwoya n'ensengeka bifuga mu ngeri elonda ebipimo ebitambuzibwa. Nnabbubi afuga ebipimo bino, nga alongoosa amawulire nga tegannatuuka ku nkola y'obwongo. Okumaliriza: Okuwulira okw'okunyeenya kusaasaanye: ekitundu ky'okulongoosa obubonero kiweebwa ku ngeri z'ebikozesebwa n'ensengeka y'obutimba, ekyokulabirako eky'okubalirira okw'omubiri okuli ebweru w'obwongo.
experiment.exp-n2-micro-sorveglianza-bio: Okwekenneenya okukozesa ebyoya n'ebisenge ng'ekyokulabirako eky'okuzuula okunyeenya awatali maanyi mangi.
Reverse engineering ya trichobothria n'okukola array za MEMS ezikwata omukka gw'empewo.
Ekyokulabirako kizuula okutambula ku mita bbiri; enkozesa ey'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) eyawandiikibwa era eyaweebwayo eri okwekenneenya kw'empisa okw'omunda.

Embeera: Trichobothria n'sensilli a fessura ez'obunnabbubi bawulira omukka gw'empewo n'okunyeenya n'okuwulira okumpi n'ekkomo ery'ebbugumu era n'amaanyi amatono ennyo, kubanga amawulire gakwatibwa mu ngeri etaliiko maanyi olw'ensengeka y'oluviiri. Ebizimbe bino kye kyokulabirako ekituufu olw'sensa ez'okukolwa ez'amaanyi amatono ennyo. Enkola: Twakola reverse engineering ey'ensengeka n'amaanyi eya trichobothria, ne tuggyamu ebipimo by'okunyeenya nga byesigamye ku bwangu n'ebipimo by'omukka, ne tukola array za MEMS eziriko ebyoya ebifaananyiriza enkola eyo, ne tuzigezesa mu galleria y'omukka ogufugibwa. Ebivaamu: Ekyokulabirako kizuula ensibuko z'okutambula okutuuka ku mita bbiri nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola z'oluviiri, nga kizzaamu okulonda okw'ekkubo okulabibwa mu butonde. Enkozesa ey'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) yawandiikibwa era yaweebwayo eri okwekenneenya kw'empisa okw'omunda. Okumaliriza: Okukwata obubonero mu ngeri efaananyiriza obutonde kisobozesa sensa z'okunyeenya n'omukka ez'amaanyi amatono ennyo; naye enkozesa zaayo zeetaaga okwekenneenya okw'obuvunaanyizibwa.
experiment.exp-n3-rigenerazione-arto-com: Okuzzaawo mu butuufu okugulu mu axolotl
Okunnyonnyola engeri blastema gy'ezzaawo okugulu n'obwesimbu obutuufu obw'ekifo oluvannyuma lw'okusala.
Okuteeka obubonero ku butoffaali n'reporters ezimasamasa n'okukwata ebifaananyi eby'okuwanvu mu bulamu (in vivo) mu kiseera ky'okuzzaawo.
Kwakakasibwa omulimu gw'ekigero kya retinoic acid mu kuzzaawo omulongoosebwa ogwa prossimo-distale.

Embeera: Axolotl (Ambystoma mexicanum) azzaawo amagulu amajjuvu oluvannyuma lw'okusala nga azzaawo mu butuufu olulyo lwa prossimo-distale. Obutoffaali bwa blastema bukuuma okujjukira ekifo kyabwo eky'ensibuko, naye obubonero obuteekawo obwesimbu bw'ekifo ku lulyo bukyali mu kusomebwa. Enkola: Twateeka obubonero ku bitundu by'obutoffaali n'reporters ezimasamasa ne tugoberera okuzzaawo n'okukwata ebifaananyi eby'okuwanvu mu bulamu, nga tukyusa n'eddagala olulyo lwa retinoic acid okukakasa omulimu gwayo ku bwesimbu bwa prossimo-distale. Ebivaamu: Okukwata ebifaananyi kukakasa nti obutoffaali obw'ekiwuzikirwa (connective) bufuga blastema nga bukuuma amawulire ag'ekifo; okwolekagana ne retinoic acid ey'ebweru kufuula omulongoosebwa prossimale, nga kuleeta ebizimbe ebisinga prossimale ku kifo ky'okusala, so ng'ekigero eky'obutonde kya retinoic acid kyetaagisa okuzzaawo olulyo olutuufu lwa prossimo-distale. Okumaliriza: Okuzzaawo olulyo lwa prossimo-distale kwesigamye ku kigero kya retinoic acid ekiyigiriza obwesimbu bw'ekifo bw'obutoffaali bwa blastema, nga bwe kikwatagana n'ekyokulabirako eky'edda eky'okufuula prossimale n'ebiva mu kulondoola obutoffaali okw'omulembe guno.
experiment.exp-n3-riprogrammazione-blast: Okuzuula obuzaale obukulu obutandika okuddayo emabega kw'obutoffaali mu kiwundu.
RNA-seq ey'obutoffaali obumu ku kitundu ekisaliddwa mu saawa 96 ezisooka oluvannyuma lw'okusala.
Kwazuulibwa akabonero k'okusomooza ak'olubereberye akakulembezebwa obuzaale bw'okuddamu kw'obukuumi bw'omubiri ne Wnt.

Embeera: Okukola blastema kyetaagisa nti obutoffaali obukuze obuli kumpi n'ekiwundu buddemu mu nkola y'obuzaala. Okuzuula obubonero obw'obutoffaali obw'olubereberye obutandika okuddayo emabega kuno kikulu okutegeera okuzzaawo. Enkola: Twakola RNA-seq ey'obutoffaali obumu (scRNA-seq) ey'ekitundu ekisaliddwa ekya axolotl mu saawa 96 ezisooka oluvannyuma lw'okusala, nga tuzimba amakubo ag'obuzaale ag'ebibinja by'obutoffaali obw'ekiwuzikirwa n'obukuumi bw'omubiri obw'obutonde mu kutandika blastema. Ebivaamu: Okwekenneenya kuzuula akabonero k'okusomooza ak'olubereberye akakulembezebwa obuzaale bw'okuddamu kw'obukuumi bw'omubiri ne Wnt/beta-catenin, nga ebika by'obutoffaali obw'ekiwuzikirwa bidda ku mbeera y'obuzaala ekwatagana ng'ey'ekibutuka. Okuyingira kwa macrophages kukulembera era kugoberera enkyukakyuka eno. Okumaliriza: Okutandika blastema mulimu ogw'emitendera mingi obubonero obw'obukuumi bw'omubiri ne Wnt mwe bikolagana okuddamu okuwandiika obutoffaali obw'ekiwuzikirwa okudda mu buzaala, ekiraga ebifo eby'obutoffaali eby'okusindika okuzzaawo.
experiment.exp-n3-rigenerazione-cardiaca: Okusoma engeri axolotl gy'addaabiriza omutima nga yeewala fibrosis ey'ebiyonsa.
Okulumya kw'ekisenge okufugibwa n'histology n'okwekenneenya okwongera kw'obutoffaali bw'omutima (cardiomiociti).
Okuddamu okw'emirimu ku nnaku 60 n'okuteeka collagen okutono, enkola eziziyiza fibrosis nga tezinnazuulibwa.

Embeera: Okwawukana n'omutima gw'ebiyonsa, oguddamu okulumizibwa n'fibrosis ey'olubeerera, amphibians ag'ekika kya urodeli gazzaawo ebinywa by'omutima ebyonoonese n'obalagala obutono. Enkola yesigamye ku busobozi bwa cardiomiociti enkulu okuddamu mu nkola y'obutoffaali n'okwongera. Enkola: Twaleeta okulumya kw'ekisenge okufugibwa ne tugoberera okuddamu n'histology, okupima okuteeka collagen n'okuteeka obubonero ku kwongera kwa cardiomiociti, nga tupima emirimu gy'okukwata ku nnaku 60. Ebivaamu: Ku nnaku 60 ekitundu kiraga okuddamu okw'emirimu n'okuteeka collagen okutono era okw'ekiseera; okuddaabiriza kuwagirwa ekibinja kya cardiomiociti ezongera n'okuddamu okuzimba matrix ey'ebweru w'obutoffaali okuyita mu macrophages, awatali kubalagala okunywevu. Enkola eziziyiza fibrosis ez'enjawulo zikyali mu kuzuulibwa. Okumaliriza: Okuzzaawo omutima kwa axolotl kugatta okwongera kwa cardiomiociti n'okufuga fibrosis kw'obukuumi bw'omubiri, nga bwe kilabibwa mu newts ne zebrafish, ekiwa ekyokulabirako olw'enkola eziziyiza fibrosis mu mutima gw'ebiyonsa.
experiment.exp-n3-crispr-guarigione-cica: Okukyusa olulyo lwa fibrosis olw'okuwonya awatali balagala
Okukakasa oba okusirisa amakubo aga fibrosis kugaziya okuzzaawo okutuukiridde ku bitundu ebirala.
Knockout ey'obutuufu n'CRISPR-Cas9 ey'abafuzi ba TGF-beta n'okugeraageranya omutindo gw'ekitundu ekiddaabirizibwa.
Okukendeeza obalagala bw'olususu, naye n'ebiva ku maanyi g'okusika g'ekitundu ekipya.

Embeera: Okuzzaawo okutuukiridde okwa axolotl kugattibwa ku kuddamu okutono ku bubonero bwa TGF-beta n'ku matrix ey'ebweru w'obutoffaali eriko fibrosis entono. Kubanga TGF-beta ye mufuzi omukulu ow'okuwonya n'obalagala, okusirisa amakubo aga fibrosis mu ngeri elonda kuyinza okugaziya okuwonya awatali balagala ku bitundu ebirala. Enkola: Nga tukozesa CRISPR-Cas9 twakola knockouts ez'obutuufu ez'abafuzi b'olulyo lwa TGF-beta ne tugeraageranya omutindo gw'ekitundu ky'olususu ekiddaabirizibwa olw'ensengeka ya collagen, obungi bwa fibronectin ne tenascin-C n'amaanyi g'okusika, nga tugeraageranya n'ebikebero ebitakyusiddwa. Ebivaamu: Okukendeeza obubonero bwa fibrosis kukendeeza nnyo obalagala bw'olususu, n'okuteeka matrix mu ngeri entegeke era efaananyiriza olususu; kyokka waliwo ebiva ku maanyi g'okusika g'ekitundu ekipya, ekiraga enjawulo wakati w'obutabaawo bw'obalagala n'obujjuvu bw'amaanyi. Okumaliriza: Okukyusa olulyo lwa TGF-beta kimala okufuula okuddaabiriza okudda ku mbeera y'okuzzaawo, naye okuzzaawo amaanyi g'okusika kyetaagisa okufuga okulonda okwa TGF-beta, nga bwe kikwatagana n'omulimu gwa TGF-beta mu kuzzaawo n'obalagala.
experiment.exp-n4-labirinto-radiale-igua: Okujjukira ebifo mu kabuzabuza akalina amagulu (radial maze)
Okupima obusobozi bw'okujjukira ebifo obwa iguana mu mulimu gw'okunoonya emmere.
Akabuzabuza akalina amagulu munaana n'empeera y'emmere n'okubala okuyingira okuddiŋŋanako.
Iguana beewala amagulu ge bamaze okukyala n'obutuufu obwa 82%, ekiraga okujjukira ebifo okunywevu.

Embeera: Okujjukira ebifo mu kukola, okuwandiikiddwa bulungi mu biyonsa n'ennyonyi, kyabuulirwa ekiseera ekiwanvu nga kikoma mu byewalula. Naye ennoonyereza ez'omu kiseera kino ku nswaswa n'enfudu ziraga obusobozi bw'ebifo obunywevu ng'enkola z'emmese zituukirizibwa ku biology y'ekika. Enkola: Twagezesa iguana mu kabuzabuza akalina amagulu munaana n'empeera y'emmere, nga tufuga obubonero bw'okuwunyiriza era nga tubala okuyingira okuddiŋŋanako mu magulu ge baamala okukyala ng'akabonero k'okujjukira ebifo mu kukola, nga twekenneenya enkola z'okulaga ekkubo nga bakozesa ebisikiriza ebiri wala. Ebivaamu: Iguana beewala amagulu ge baamala okukyala n'obutuufu obwa 82%, ekisukka nnyo ku kigero ky'okugwa buli mulundi, awatali kwesigama ku bubonero bw'okuwunyiriza, era bakozesa ebisikiriza ebiri wala ku kabuzabuza okwetereeza, ekiraga okukozesa ekifaananyi eky'ekifo okusinga enkola ey'okuddamu obwereere. Okumaliriza: Iguana balina okujjukira ebifo mu kukola okunywevu okwenkanankana n'okulabibwa mu byewalula ebirala (amnioti), ekiwagira obukakafu obweyongera nti amagezi g'ebifo ag'ebyewalula gaawulirwako wansi w'ekyalyo.
Okukakasa oba iguana bayiga emirimu nga bakwetegereza munnaabwe ng'alaga.
Ekigezo ky'okuggulawo oluggi olusaaga n'ebibinja ebyetegereza ng'ogeraageranya n'ebibinja ebitamanyi.
Abeetegereza bagonjoola omulimu okwa bwangu, kye kabonero akasooka ak'okuwaayo mu bwenkanya mu byewalula bino.

Embeera: Okuyiga mu bwenkanya, edda okwabuulirwa ng'okw'ebika eby'obwenkanya eby'ebiyonsa n'ebiyonsa, kwakakasibwa ne mu byewalula ebitali bya bwenkanya, ekisoomooza endowooza nti kwe kutuukiriza obulamu obw'ekibinja. Enkola: Twateeka iguana mu mulimu gw'okuggulawo oluggi olusaaga, nga tugeraageranya ebibinja ebyetegereza, ebyayolekera munnaabwe ng'alaga, n'ebibinja ebitamanyi; embeera y'okukebera eya ghost yawula omulimu gw'okwongera obubonero obwereere. Ebivaamu: Abeetegereza bagonjoola omulimu okwa bwangu era n'okugezaako okutono okusinga ebibinja ebitamanyi, era obusobozi bwabwe tebusobola kunnyonnyolwa n'okwongera obubonero obw'ekifo obwereere oba okwefaananyiriza ekigendererwa, ekiraga okuwaayo amawulire mu bwenkanya. Ekivaamu kifugibwa emyaka gy'ensolo. Okumaliriza: Ebivaamu bino biwa akabonero akasooka ak'okuyiga mu bwenkanya olw'okwetegereza mu byewalula bino, nga bwe kikwatagana n'obukakafu bw'okwefaananyiriza n'enkyukakyuka mu nneeyisa ebyamaze okulagibwa mu byewalula ebirala, era biraga nti enkola z'okuyiga mu bwenkanya za dda mu kwezaala.
experiment.exp-n4-autocontrollo-gratific: Okwekenneenya obusobozi bwa iguana obw'okulwawo okuddamu olw'empeera esingako.
Omulimu gw'okulonda okulwiddwa n'obungi bw'emmere obweyongera okusinziira ku kiseera ky'okulinda.
Ensolo ezimu zigumira okulinda okutuuka ku sikonda 30, n'enjawulo nnene wakati w'ensolo emu n'endala.

Embeera: Okufuga, kwe kugaana okuddamu okw'amaanyi olw'okufuna omugaso oguddibwako, kye kimu ku bitundu ebikulu eby'enkola y'okukola (executive function). Emisingi gyayo egy'okwenkanya mu byewalula n'ebiyonsa gyagattibwa ku bunene bw'obwongo, naye data ku byewalula zikyali ntono. Enkola: Twekenneenya iguana mu mulimu gw'okulonda okulwiddwa, obungi bw'emmere we bweyongera okusinziira ku kiseera ky'okulinda, ne mu nkyukakyuka y'omulimu gw'ekiseke (cylinder task) okupima okugaana okuddamu okulaga eri empeera. Ebivaamu: Ensolo ezimu zigumira okulinda okutuuka ku sikonda 30 nga tezinnaddamu, n'enjawulo nnene wakati w'ensolo emu n'endala; obusobozi mu mulimu gw'ekiseke bulaga okugaana okukwatagana n'embeera era bufugibwa okuyiga, nga bwe kikwatagana n'ebipimo eby'omu makkati ebyalagibwa mu byewalula ebirala. Okumaliriza: Iguana balaga okufuga okupimibwa naye okukyukakyuka, nga bwe kikwatagana n'endowooza nti obusobozi bw'okufuga bugendera n'obunene bw'obwongo n'embeera y'okugaana okuddamu mu byewalula.
experiment.exp-n4-riconoscimento-individ: Okuzuula omuntu ssekinnoomu wakati w'ab'ekika kimu
Okukakasa oba iguana bawula ensolo ssekinnoomu era bajjukira enkolagana ezaakubaawo.
Ekigezo ky'okumanyiira-n'okuddamu-okuwuniikirira n'ebisikiriza eby'okuwunyiriza n'eby'okulaba eby'ensolo ezimanyiddwa n'ezitali zimanyiddwa.
Okuddamu okuwuniikirira okulonda eri ensolo empya; ensolo ezimu zirina enneeyisa ezizibu okunnyonnyolwa n'okuyiga kwokka.

Embeera: Okuzuula omuntu ssekinnoomu, omusingi gw'ensengeka z'obufuzi, obwannannyini bw'ekifo n'enkolagana ez'ekika kya muliraanwa-mulabe, kwawandiikibwa mu nswaswa eziwera eziwula ab'ekika kimu abamanyiddwa n'abatali bamanyiddwa okusinga nga bakozesa obubonero obw'okuwunyiriza. Enkola: Twakozesa enkola y'okumanyiira-n'okuddamu-okuwuniikirira nga tulaga iguana ebisikiriza eby'okuwunyiriza n'eby'okulaba eby'ensolo ezimanyiddwa n'ezitali zimanyiddwa, nga tubala emirundi n'ekiseera ky'okwetegereza, naddala ebigezo eby'olulimi eby'okwolekera obubonero obw'akaloosa. Ebivaamu: Ensolo zilaga okuddamu okuwuniikirira okulonda eri ensolo empya, nga zeetegereza obubonero bwazo obw'akaloosa ekiseera ekiwanvu okusinga obw'ensolo ezimanyiddwa, ekiraga obusobozi bw'okuzuula ab'ekika kimu ssekinnoomu n'okujjukira obwesimbu bwabwe. Ensolo ezimu zirina enneeyisa ezitasoboka kunnyonnyolwa n'okuyiga kw'okugatta kwokka. Okumaliriza: Iguana bawula ensolo ssekinnoomu okusinziira ku bubonero bw'akaloosa era bakuuma obwesimbu bwazo ku biseera, nga bwe kikwatagana n'obukakafu bw'okuzuula omuntu ssekinnoomu obuyita mu bubonero obw'akaloosa mu byewalula n'okuddamu okulowooza ku magezi gaabwo ag'obwenkanya.
experiment.exp-n5-proteomica-veleno.obie: Okuwandiika obutwa bw'emisota egikulu egy'omu laabu okuzuula ebifo eby'eddagala.
experiment.exp-n5-proteomica-veleno.meto: Mass spectrometry ey'oluddiŋŋana ku butwa obugabaniziddwa n'okukola maapu y'ebitundu bya puloteyina ebikola.
experiment.exp-n5-proteomica-veleno.risu: Byazuulibwa ebibinja 47 eby'obutwa, bisatu ku byo nga bisuubiza ng'eddagala eriwonya obulumi.
experiment.exp-n5-proteomica-veleno.abst: Ekigendererwa. Okuzimba enkalala ey'okwenkanya ey'obutwa bw'emisota egikulu egy'omu laabu eza Eden Exotic (ensi ya 47B) okuzuula ebifo eby'eddagala ebiyinza okukozesebwa. Enkola. Obutwa bwagabaniziddwa n'RP-HPLC era buli kitundu kyakebebwa n'mass spectrometry ey'oluddiŋŋana (bottom-up ne top-down), nga bawa ebibinja by'obutwa n'okukola maapu y'ebitundu bya puloteyina ebikola nga bakozesa bbanka za data za proteomics. Ebivaamu. Kwazuulibwa ebibinja 47 eby'obutwa obuddiŋŋanako, obukulembezebwa fosfolipasi A2, metalloprotease, serina-protease n'obutwa obwa three-finger; okwekenneenya kwalaga enjawulo nnene wakati w'ebika mu bungi. Peptides bisatu obwa three-finger obw'obungi obutono byalaga okukwatagana n'amakubo ag'obulumi mu bigezo eby'olubereberye, ekibifuula abakugu ab'okuwonya obulumi. Okumaliriza. Proteomics ey'okwenkanya ewa maapu ey'amagezi ey'obutwa ng'ekitabo ky'ebikwata (ligands) ebikola era ekwataganya okulonda ebifo eby'eddagala, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola ya venomics emanyiddwa.
experiment.exp-n5-peptide-antipertensivo: Peptides ezikola ku misuwa ez'okukozesebwa mu bujjanjabi
Okukola eddagala eriziyiza puleesa eriva mu peptides ez'obutwa ezongera bradykinin.
Okukola peptides n'ebigezo eby'okuziyiza ACE ku nkola z'obutoffaali n'ebitundu.
Ekifaananyi kimu kiraga okuziyiza okunywevu mu laabu (in vitro); pharmacokinetics mu bulamu (in vivo) ekyali ntono.

Ekigendererwa. Okukola eddagala eriziyiza puleesa eriva mu peptides ezongera bradykinin (BPP) ez'obutwa, nga bakozesa obusobozi bwazo obw'okuziyiza enzima ekyusa angiotensin (ACE). Enkola. Ebifaananyi ebijjudde proline byakolebwa n'okukola peptides mu ngeri enkalu (solid phase) ne bigezesebwa olw'okuziyiza ACE ku bitundu n'nnyiriri z'obutoffaali, nga bapima ebipimo by'okuziyiza n'obunywevu mu serum; pharmacokinetics yapimibwa mu bulamu. Ebivaamu. Ekifaananyi ekyalongoosebwa kyalaga okuziyiza ACE okw'amaanyi era okunywevu mu laabu, n'okwongera okuddamu kwa bradykinin okuwooza puleesa okukwatagana n'enkola ya BPP eyaleeta captopril. Kyokka ebivaamu mu bulamu byakomebwa okwonoonebwa okwa bwangu n'obutamalirira mu kunywa mu kamwa. Okumaliriza. Obutwa bukakasa omugaso gwabwo ng'ensibuko z'ebifo eby'okuziyiza ACE; okulongoosa pharmacokinetics kye kiziyiza ekikulu eri okuvvuunula mu bujjanjabi.
experiment.exp-n5-antiveleno-ricombinant: Eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa eritamu bika bingi (recombinant)
Okukola eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa erikoleddwa erikola ku busagwa bw'ebika bingi awatali kuwa nsolo kingambo.
Okulonda antibodies ez'omuntu okuva mu bbanka za phage display okulwana obutwa obukoleddwa.
Okuziyiza okugatte kw'ebika bibiri mu laabu; obusobozi ku metalloproteinasi bukyali kitundu.

Ekigendererwa. Okukola eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa eritamu bika bingi, erikola ku busagwa bw'ebika bingi era eritetaaga kuwa nsolo kingambo. Enkola. Obutwa obukoleddwa obukiirira (three-finger toxins, alpha-neurotoxins ez'omuguwa omuwanvu, metalloprotease) byakozesebwa ng'antigens okulonda ebitundu bya antibodies eby'omuntu okuva mu bbanka za phage display; ebikwata ebisinga byakyusibwa okuba IgG ne bigezesebwa mu bigezo by'okuziyiza mu laabu ne mu mmese. Ebivaamu. Antibody emu ey'omuntu eziyiza obungi yaziyiza alpha-neurotoxins ez'ebika bibiri eby'elapidi n'okuziyiza okugatte ku kigero ekitono, n'okwongera obulamu bw'ensolo ezaajjanjabibwa. Okuziyiza metalloprotease ezivaamu omusaayi kwakoma ku kitundu, ekiraga obwetaavu bw'ekigatta eky'antibodies eziwera. Okumaliriza. Tekinologiya ya phage display esobozesa eddagala eriziyiza obusagwa ery'omuntu eritali ludde era eddibwamu; okugaziya eri obutwa obulumya ebitundu kyetaagisa okugatta antibodies eziwera eziyambagana.
Okuwandiika obwangu n'okuddibwamu kw'okuziyiza obwongo n'ebinywa okuleetebwa alpha-neurotoxins.
Electrophysiology ku bitundu by'omuyaayu n'ebinywa n'okukola enkola y'okukwata ku receptor.
Kwatereezebwa ekifaananyi eky'ekiseera-n'ekivaamu; ebiwandiiko eby'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) biri mu kwekenneenya okukomeddwa ne N10.

Ekigendererwa. Okuwandiika obwangu bw'okutandika n'okuddibwamu kw'okuziyiza obwongo n'ebinywa okuleetebwa alpha-neurotoxins, okuteekawo ekifaananyi eky'ekiseera-n'ekivaamu n'obukoma bw'obukuumi. Enkola. Ebitundu by'omuyaayu n'ebinywa ebyawuddwa byakozesebwa mu kuwandiika kwa electrophysiology (voltage clamp n'end-plate potentials) mu kiseera ky'okuteeka alpha-neurotoxins ez'omuguwa omumpi n'omuwanvu; emabega g'okuziyiza amasannyalaze ag'acetylcholine gaakolebwa mu nkola z'okukwata ku receptor ya nicotinic ey'ebinywa, nga bapima ebipimo by'okwegatta n'okwawukana. Ebivaamu. Obutwa obw'omuguwa omumpi bwalaga okutandika okwa bwangu n'okuddamu okwa mpola era okwa kitundu okwa receptor y'ebinywa, so ng'ebimu byalaga okuddibwamu okusingako. Enkola yazzaamu ekifaananyi eky'ekiseera-n'ekivaamu ekyalabibwa n'ebipimo bya IC50 mu kigero kya nanomolar. Okumaliriza. Kwatereezebwa embeera ey'obuwendo ey'okuziyiza obwongo n'ebinywa; olw'enkozesa ebbiri (dual-use) ey'data, ebiwandiiko biri mu kwekenneenya okukomeddwa ne N10 nga tebinnaba kusaasaanyizibwa.
experiment.exp-n6-forza-morso-varani.obi: Okupima amaanyi n'obugumu bw'ebinywa n'amagumba bw'enswaswa nga zisitudde omugugu.
experiment.exp-n6-forza-morso-varani.met: Sensa z'amaanyi ku kuluma n'okwekenneenya okutambula okwa bwangu mu kugwira.
experiment.exp-n6-forza-morso-varani.ris: Kwawandiikibwa amaanyi agasukka 25% ku bipimo eby'obunene (allometric).
experiment.exp-n6-forza-morso-varani.abs: Ekigendererwa. Okupima amaanyi g'okuluma n'obugumu bw'ebinywa n'amagumba bw'enswaswa nga zisitudde omugugu, nga tugatta okupima okutereevu n'okukola enkola z'ensengeka. Enkola. Sensa z'amaanyi ezaateekebwa ku kuluma zaawandiika ebiseera eby'amaanyi mu kukwata okw'okwerondamu, so ng'okuvidiyo okwa bwangu kwazzaamu okutambula kw'okugwira; ebifaananyi bya ssatu eby'ekiwanga ebyava mu tomography byakebebwa n'enkola ya finite elements okupima okusaasaana kw'okunyigirizibwa mu kuluma n'okusika. Ebivaamu. Amaanyi agaapimibwa gaasukka 25% ku bipimo eby'obunene; naye okwekenneenya kw'ensengeka kwalaga nti ekiwanga tekitegekeddwa lwa kuluma kw'amaanyi mangi wabula lwa kugumira okunyigirizibwa okuzinga n'okusika kw'enkola ya grip-and-rip. Okumaliriza. Mu nswaswa okukola okw'obuyiggo kwesigamye ku kugatta wakati w'ebinywa eby'amaanyi n'ensengeka y'ekiwanga eyeetongodde mu kusika, okusinga amaanyi g'okuggalawo gokka, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola za biomechanics ezimanyiddwa ku Varanus.
experiment.exp-n6-resilienza-ipossia.obi: Okwekenneenya obugumu bw'enswaswa ku mulimu omuwanvu mu bifo eby'oxygen entono.
experiment.exp-n6-resilienza-ipossia.met: Ebigezo ku tapis roulant mu kisenge ky'oxygen efugibwa n'okulondoola lactate mu musaayi.
experiment.exp-n6-resilienza-ipossia.ris: Okuddamu kwa lactate okwa bwangu okusinga ebikebero, olw'okussa okwa gular pump okulungi.
experiment.exp-n6-resilienza-ipossia.abs: Ekigendererwa. Okwekenneenya obugumu bw'enswaswa ku mulimu omuwanvu mu bifo eby'oxygen entono n'enkola eziwagira endurance. Enkola. Ensolo zaateekebwa mu bigezo ku tapis roulant mu kisenge ky'oxygen efugibwa, nga balondoola okussa, okupima okukozesa oxygen okusinga n'okukebera lactate mu musaayi mu mulimu n'okuddamu. Ebivaamu. Enswaswa zaakuuma enkola y'omubiri ey'amaanyi mangi ekwatagana bulungi n'endurance; mu oxygen entono ey'ekigero, okussa kwawagirwa gular pump ey'amaanyi, eyeeyongera ku kussa okw'olubatu. Okuddamu kwa lactate kwali kwa bwangu okusinga ebikebero, nga bwe kikwatagana n'okulungi kw'okussa okw'okuyamba. Okumaliriza. Gular pump ye nkyukakyuka enkulu, nga eyawula okussa n'okutambula, ekendeeza ku kunyigirizibwa kw'omugongo era kulongoosa okugumira omulimu mu oxygen entono, nga bwe kikwatagana ne physiology emanyiddwa ey'enswaswa (varanidi).
experiment.exp-n6-termoregolazione-estre: Okuzuula ekifo ky'ebbugumu enswaswa mwe zikuumira obusobozi bw'okutambula obujjuvu.
Telemetry y'ebbugumu ery'omubiri n'ebigezo by'okutambula ku bbugumu eryeyongera.
Emirimu eginywevu okutuuka ku 40 dditiigulu, n'okugwa okwa bwangu okw'okukwataganya okusukka ekkomo.

Ekigendererwa. Okuzuula ekifo ky'ebbugumu enswaswa mwe zikuumira obusobozi bw'okutambula obujjuvu n'okuteeka ekkomo ery'okugwa kw'okukwataganya. Enkola. Ebbugumu ery'omubiri lyawandiikibwa n'telemetry mu bigezo by'okutambula ku bbugumu eryeyongera; obwangu bw'okudduka, obungi n'obuwanvu bw'ekigere byapimibwa n'okuvidiyo, era emirimu gyagattibwa ku mabega g'ebbugumu n'okupima ebipimo bya Q10. Ebivaamu. Emirimu gy'okutambula ginywevu okutuuka ku 40 dditiigulu, n'okwesigama okutono ku bbugumu mu kifo ekyagalibwa, oluvannyuma lw'okugwa okwa bwangu okw'okukwataganya okusukka ekkomo, nga bwe kikwatagana n'ekifaananyi ekitali kyenkanankana eky'amabega g'ebbugumu. Amaanyi g'ebinywa gaalabika ng'ekiziyiza ekikulu ku bbugumu ery'amaanyi. Okumaliriza. Enswaswa zirina ekifo ekigazi eky'ebbugumu eky'emirimu ejjuvu naye n'obukoma obutono okusukka ekkomo, ekikoma okukozesebwa mu bifo eby'ebbugumu ery'ekitalo, nga bwe kikwatagana n'ebyawandiikibwa ku kwesigama kw'okutambula ku bbugumu mu byewalula.
experiment.exp-n6-integrazione-operativa: Obusobozi bw'okusitula n'okukozesa mu mirimu n'omugugu
Okusoma omugugu enswaswa gwe zisobola okusitula olw'enkozesa mu mirimu egilabirirwa.
Ebigezo by'okutambula n'ebisibo ebiriko sensa ebiriko emigugu egyeyongera n'okwekenneenya okukoowa.
Omugugu ogusobola okusitulwa okutuuka ku 15% ku buzito bw'omubiri; enkola y'obulamu yakyusibwa oluvannyuma lw'okugaana okw'omunda.

Ekigendererwa. Okusoma omugugu enswaswa gwe zisobola okusitula n'okukoowa okugattiddwa, olw'enkozesa mu mirimu egilabirirwa. Enkola. Ensolo zaatambula mu makubo agaliko sensa nga zitwadde ebisibo ebiriko emigugu egyeyongera; kwawandiikibwa okukozesa amaanyi, endurance ku kkubo eky'eŋŋanda, okutambula kw'ekigere n'okuddamu kwa lactate, nga bagatta n'okwekenneenya obubonero bw'obulamu. Ebivaamu. Omugugu ogusobola okusitulwa awatali kwonoona okutambula gwali kumpi ne 15% ku buzito bw'omubiri; okusukka ekkomo eryo, endurance yagwa amangu era okukozesa amaanyi kwakula mu ngeri etali ntereevu, n'obubonero bw'okukoowa kw'ebinywa n'amagumba. Enkola y'omubiri ey'amaanyi mangi ey'enswaswa yasobozesa emirimu okusinga eyali esuubirwa olw'obunene. Okumaliriza. Waliwo ekkomo ery'omugugu okusukka lyo obwenkanya wakati w'okukozesa amaanyi n'emirimu bugwa amangu; olw'okugaana okw'omunda ku bulamu bw'ensolo, enkola yakyusibwa okukoma emigugu n'ekiseera ky'ebigezo mu bukoma obw'obwegendereza.
experiment.exp-n7-osmoregolazione-marina: Okunnyonnyola engeri enfudu ez'omu nnyanja gye zikuuma obwenkanya bw'amazzi mu munnyo omungi.
Okupima ekigero ky'okufuluma kw'ebisenge by'omunnyo eby'amaziga nga zisitudde omunnyo ogufugibwa.
Obusobozi bw'okufulumya obusinga ebipimo, n'okufuga kwa homoni okwongera obulungi okusinga bwe kyasuubirwa.

Ekigendererwa. Okunnyonnyola engeri enfudu ez'omu nnyanja gye zikuuma obwenkanya bw'amazzi n'omunnyo mu munnyo omungi, nga tupima obusobozi bw'okufulumya bw'ebisenge by'omunnyo. Enkola. Nga zisitudde omunnyo ogufugibwa (okufuka amazzi ag'omunnyo) kwapimibwa ekigero ky'okufuluma kw'ebisenge by'omunnyo eby'amaziga, nga bapima obungi bw'omunnyo n'obwangu bw'okufulumya sodium ne potassium mu maziga; ebipimo by'omusaayi nga hematocrit ne sodium mu musaayi byalondoola okuddamu kw'omubiri. Ebivaamu. Okufuluma kw'ebisenge kwatuuka ku bungi obw'omunnyo obusinga plasma n'amazzi g'ennyanja, n'obusobozi bw'okufulumya obusinga ebipimo; okufuga okuddamu ku munnyo kwalabika ng'okufugibwa homoni okusinga bwe kyasuubirwa. Awatali kutuuka ku mazzi g'ennyanja, kwalabibwa okukala okwa bwangu n'okwongera kwa hematocrit ne sodium. Okumaliriza. Ebisenge by'omunnyo ebiri ebweru w'ensigo kye kimu ekikulu eky'okutereeza omunnyo mu byewalula eby'omu nnyanja, n'okufuga okukyukakyuka okusukka ebiragulwa eby'enkola ez'edda.
Okukakasa okukozesa magineeti w'ensi nga maapu olw'okwetereeza ku bbanga eddene.
Okwolekera magineeti ezikoleddwa mu maserene n'okuwandiika ekkubo ery'okuwuga ery'obwana.
Enfudu zikyusa ekkubo okusinziira ku bbanga (latitude) eryakolebwa, ekikakasa maapu ya magineeti.

Ekigendererwa. Okukakasa oba obwana bw'enfudu ez'omu nnyanja bukozesa magineeti w'ensi nga maapu olw'okwetereeza ku bbanga eddene, okusukka ku kompasi. Enkola. Mu maserene ag'eŋŋanda, ensolo zaayolekerwa magineeti ezizzaamu obubonero (amaanyi n'okusuula) obw'ebifo eby'enjawulo ku kkubo ery'okusenguka; ekkubo ery'okuwuga lyawandiikibwa era lyakebebwa n'ebibalo eby'eŋŋanda okukakasa okukwatagana n'ekifo ekyakolebwa. Ebivaamu. Enfudu zaakyusa ekkubo mu ngeri ekwatagana ne latitude n'ekifo ebyakolebwa magineeti, nga zeetereeza ng'ezandiddewo ku kkubo ery'okusenguka ery'entuufu. Kino kikakasa obusobozi bw'okuggya amawulire ag'ekifo aga bicoordinate okuva ku magineeti w'ensi, agaawukana ku mawulire ag'ekkubo obwereere. Okumaliriza. Ebivaamu biwagira nti waliwo maapu ya magineeti ey'amazima mu byewalula eby'omu nnyanja, ebitundu bya magineeti mwe bikola ng'obubonero bw'okulaga ekkubo, nga bwe kikwatagana n'obukakafu obwa loggerhead ne Chelonia mydas.
experiment.exp-n7-longevita-senescenza-t: Okuzuula enkola z'obutoffaali ezisibuka obuwangaazi obungi obw'ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja.
Okwekenneenya obuwanvu bwa telomeres n'okunyigirizibwa okw'oxidative ku bibinja by'emyaka egy'enjawulo ennyo.
Okumenyeka kwa telomeres okutono nnyo n'obukuumi bwa antioxidant obwa waggulu ne ku nsolo enkulu.

Ekigendererwa. Okuzuula enkola z'obutoffaali ezisibuka obuwangaazi obungi obw'ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja n'okukebera endowooza ey'obukadde obw'okutebenkevu. Enkola. Ku bibinja by'emyaka egy'enjawulo ennyo kwapimibwa obuwanvu bwa telomeres n'obukuumi bwa antioxidant bw'ebitundu, wamu n'obubonero bw'obwonoonefu obwa oxidative; emitendera gy'okufa n'ebipimo bya biochemistry byageraageranyizibwa wakati w'ebibinja by'emyaka okupima enkola y'okukaddiwa. Ebivaamu. Okumenyeka kwa telomeres kwali kutono nnyo n'obukuumi bwa antioxidant obw'obutonde obwa waggulu ne ku nsolo enkulu, n'obwonoonefu obwa oxidative obutono. Emitendera gy'obukadde gyalabika ng'egyakendeezebwa oba egitatebenkevu mu kitundu ekinene eky'ekyokulabirako, wadde nga tetuggyamu okugwa kw'obulamu okw'oluvannyuma okulabibwa mu bibinja eby'obutonde. Okumaliriza. Obuwangaazi obw'ekitalo obw'enfudu bulabika ng'obuwagirwa okuddukanya okulungi kw'okunyigirizibwa okwa oxidative n'okumenyeka kwa telomeres okwa mpola, nga bwe kikwatagana n'obukakafu obw'okwenkanya obuteeka ebika bingi mu biramu eby'obukadde obwa mpola oba obw'okutebenkevu.
experiment.exp-n7-immersione-metabolismo: Okutegeera engeri emirimu gy'ebitundu gye gikuumibwa mu kunnyika okuwanvu okw'oxygen entono.
Telemetry y'okukuba kw'omutima n'okukebera gaasi mu musaayi mu kunnyika okw'okugezesa.
Okukendeera kw'omutima okungi n'okugaba omusaayi obuggya; amakubo agamu ag'okukuuma gagabanibwa n'ebifaananyi bya axolotl owa N3.

Ekigendererwa. Okutegeera engeri emirimu gy'ebitundu gye gikuumibwa mu kunnyika okuwanvu okw'oxygen entono mu byewalula eby'omu nnyanja. Enkola. Mu kunnyika okw'okugezesa, okukuba kw'omutima n'okutambula byalondoolebwa n'telemetry, nga bakebera gaasi mu musaayi n'obubonero bw'enkola ey'awatali oxygen; okuddamu kw'omutima n'emisuwa kwagattibwa ku buwanvu n'ekiseera ky'okunnyika. Ebivaamu. Kwalabibwa okukendeera kw'omutima okungi mu kunnyika okuwanvu, n'okugwa okw'ekiseera okw'okukuba kw'omutima n'okugaba omusaayi obuggya eri ebitundu ebikulu, okukuuma obutereke bwa oxygen obw'olubatu. Okukendeeza enkola y'omubiri n'obukuumi bwa antioxidant kwakoma obwonoonefu obw'okuddamu okuyingiza oxygen ku kuzuuka. Amakubo agamu ag'okukuuma obutoffaali gaalabika ng'agagabanibwa n'ebifaananyi eby'okugumira okubulwa oxygen okwa axolotl owa N3. Okumaliriza. Okugumira okunnyika kw'ebyewalula eby'omu nnyanja kugatta okukendeera kw'omutima, okugaba omusaayi n'okukendeeza enkola y'omubiri, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola ezimanyiddwa ez'okugumira okubulwa oxygen mu byewalula.
experiment.exp-n8-cromatofori-nanocrista: Okunnyonnyola enkola y'omubiri ey'okukyusa langi okwa bwangu mu nnankinsooki.
Microscopy y'amasannyalaze ne spectrophotometry ya chromatophores nga zeekubirwa mu ngeri efugibwa.
Kwakakasibwa nti okutereeza okukola kwa nanocrystals za guanina kuleeta langi ey'ensengeka, si pigmenti zokka.

Embeera. Ku ekifo N8 ekya Eden Exotic (ensi ya 47B) kwanoonyerezebwa omusingi gw'omubiri ogw'okukyusa langi okwa bwangu mu nnankinsooki, nga bawula ekitundu kya pigmenti ku kya langi ey'ensengeka (structural colour). Enkola. Ebyokulabirako by'olususu okuva ku nsolo ezeekubirwa mu ngeri efugibwa byakebebwa n'microscopy y'amasannyalaze (transmission electron microscopy) ne spectrophotometry ey'okumasamasa, nga bagatta ensengeka y'omuguddo gwa nanocrystals za guanina mu iridofori ku mabega agaapimibwa mu kukyuka okwaleetebwa. Ebivaamu. Enkyukakyuka ya langi tennyonnyolwa n'okusaasaana oba okugatta kwa pigmenti kwokka: ensolo zifuga mu ngeri ekola okutereeza wakati wa nanocrystals mu ddaala ery'ebweru erya iridofori, nga zikyusa ekiseera eky'okumasamasa okuva ku kiragala-bbulaa okudda ku kyenvu-kyofumbe, nga bwe kikwatagana n'endowooza ya photonic crystals. Eddaala eppa erya iridofori eririko kristaalo ennene liwooza ekitundu ekiri kumpi n'infrared. Okumaliriza. Langi y'ennankinsooki y'ensengeka okusinga era efugibwa mu ngeri ekola; ekyokulabirako eky'amaddaala abiri kigatta okwekweka, okuwa obubonero n'okukuuma ebbugumu, era kiwa omusingi gw'enkola olw'enkola z'enneeyisa ez'ekifo N8.
experiment.exp-n8-mimetismo-adattivo.obi: Okupima obwangu n'obutuufu nnankinsooki bye zikyusaamu langi okutuukira ku mbeera egyetoolodde.
experiment.exp-n8-mimetismo-adattivo.met: Ebifo ebiriko emabega ag'enjawulo n'okwekenneenya langi okugeraageranyizibwa ku kulaba kw'abazannyi.
experiment.exp-n8-mimetismo-adattivo.ris: Okwetereeza okulungi ku bintu eby'obutonde, okutali kutuufu ku bifaananyi ebikoleddwa eby'enjawulo ennyo.
experiment.exp-n8-mimetismo-adattivo.abs: Embeera. Ekifo N8 kyapima obwangu n'obutuufu nnankinsooki bwe zikyusaamu langi okutuukira ku mbeera (background matching), nga bapima emirimu okuva ku ndaba y'abazannyi. Enkola. Ensolo zaayolekerwa mu bifo ebiriko emabega ag'obutonde n'agakoleddwa; okumasamasa kw'olususu kwawandiikibwa n'spectrophotometry era ebipimo byateekebwa mu bifo bya langi ebikola okulaba kw'abazannyi ab'ennyonyi n'emisota, nga babalirira ebbanga ery'okulaba (JND) wakati w'ensolo n'emabega. Ebivaamu. Ku bintu eby'obutonde (obususu, amakoola) okwetereeza kwa bwangu era kulungi, nga kikendeeza enjawulo wansi w'ekipimo ky'okwawula ky'abazannyi mu ddakiika ntono. Ku bifaananyi ebikoleddwa eby'enjawulo ennyo okutuukira kikoma ku kitundu, nga bwe kikwatagana n'endowooza nti enkola etegekeddwa lwa langi ez'obutonde. Okuddamu era kwesigamye ku muzannyi. Okumaliriza. Okwekweka kw'ennankinsooki mulimu ogukola era ogukwatagana n'embeera, naye ogukomeddwa langi ezaakula; ebivaamu biteekawo obukoma obw'omu mirimu obuteekwa okukwatibwa mu pulogulaamu z'okuta n'okuzza ez'ekifo N8.
experiment.exp-n8-segnalazione-sociale-c: Okwawula okukozesa langi olw'okwekweka ku kw'okuwuliziganya wakati w'ensolo.
Okuwandiika ebifaananyi bya langi mu kusisinkana kw'ebifo n'ebifaananyi eby'ensolo ebiriko langi ez'obulijjo.
Langi ezaaka ku mbiriizi ziragula ekivaamu ky'entalo, ekiraga omulimu gw'akabonero ogwawukana.

Embeera. Ku N8 kwakakasibwa oba okukyusa langi kw'ennankinsooki, okusukka ku kwekweka, kuyamba okuwuliziganya wakati w'ensolo, nga bawula emirimu ebiri. Enkola. Mu kusisinkana kw'ebifo okw'obulijjo n'ebifaananyi eby'ensolo ebiriko langi, ebifaananyi bya langi eby'omu mbiriizi, omutwe n'obukoloboze byawandiikibwa n'imaging ey'okumasamasa okungi era byakebebwa olw'okumasamasa, okujjula n'obwangu bw'okukyuka, nga bagatta ku kivaamu ky'entalo. Ebivaamu. Langi ezaaka eziriko ku mbiriizi n'omutwe mu kwongera entalo ziragula ekivaamu ky'okulwana: ensolo ezituuka ku kumasamasa okungi okw'omutwe n'obwangu okw'okukyuka ziwangula emirundi mingi, so ng'abawanguddwa batwala langi ennafu. Ebitundu by'omubiri eby'enjawulo bitambuza amawulire ag'enjawulo (okwagala okusembera ku busobozi bw'okuvuganya). Obubonero buno bukola ku bipimo bya langi n'ebifo ebyawukana ku ebyo ebikozesebwa mu background matching. Okumaliriza. Langi mu nnankinsooki erina omulimu gw'akabonero ogwawukana ku kwekweka; omulimu ogubiri, ogufugibwa iridofori ez'emu, gukwataganya enkola z'okuddukanya obwenkanya mu buggya ez'ekifo N8.
experiment.exp-n8-conservazione-reintrod: Obusobozi bw'okuzza mu nsiko ebibinja eby'omu buggya
Okwekenneenya oba nnankinsooki ez'omu buggya zikuuma obusobozi bw'okwekweka obwetaagisa mu butonde.
Okugeraageranya okuddamu kwa langi n'okwewala abalabe wakati w'ensolo ez'omu buggya n'ez'omu nsiko mu mbeera eyeekuusa ku butonde.
Ez'omu buggya zirina okuddamu okwa mpola; pulogulaamu y'okugaggawaza obutonde yatandikibwa okujjuza ekiwaatwa.

Embeera. Ekifo N8 kyapima obusobozi bw'okuzza mu nsiko nnankinsooki ezaakuzibwa mu buggya, nga bakebera okukuuma obusobozi bw'okwekweka n'okwewala abalabe obwetaagisa mu butonde. Enkola. Mu mbeera eyeekuusa ku butonde kwageraageranyizibwa okuddamu kwa langi okutuukira ku mbeera, ekiseera eky'okukyusa langi n'enneeyisa ez'okwewala abalabe (okusirika, okuzunga, okudduka) wakati w'ensolo ez'omu buggya n'ez'omu nsiko, n'ebisikiriza eby'abalabe ebikoleddwa n'okwekenneenya langi okugeraageranyizibwa ku kulaba kw'abalabe. Ebivaamu. Ez'omu buggya zirina okuddamu kwa langi okwa mpola era okutali kujjuvu n'enneeyisa z'okwewala abalabe ezikendedde okusinga ez'omu nsiko, nga bwe kikwatagana n'okubulwa okuwulira n'okwolekagana okutono n'abalabe okw'omu buggya. Enjawulo zikendeera oluvannyuma lwa pulogulaamu y'okugaggawaza obutonde n'ebintu eby'enjawulo n'okutendeka okw'okwewala abalabe. Okumaliriza. Obuggya bunafuya naye tebumalawo obusobozi bw'okwekweka; okutendeka okw'okwewala abalabe nga tebannaba kutebwa n'okugaggawaza kwe kirungi okugatta ensolo ku mutindo gw'okuwona mu nsiko, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola ennungi ez'okuzza mu nsiko ez'ekifo N8.
experiment.exp-n9-modello-adattamento-fr: Okuragula enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale ki eziyamba okugumira obunnyogovu mu bika eby'ectothermic.
Enkola za machine learning eziyigirizibwa ku data z'obuzaale ez'okwenkanya n'ebifaananyi by'ebbugumu ebimanyiddwa.
Enkola ezuula obuzaale bwa antifreeze n'obw'enkola y'amasavu n'obutuufu obwa 78%.

Embeera: Okugumira obunnyogovu mu bika eby'ectothermic kwesigamye ku nkyukakyuka z'obutoffaali nga puloteyina eziziyiza obunnyogovu (antifreeze proteins), abakola nnyonta n'okuzza obuggya enkola y'amasavu. Enkola: Twayigiriza enkola za machine learning ku data z'obuzaale ez'okwenkanya n'ebifaananyi by'ebbugumu ebimanyiddwa, nga tugatta okulonda ebipimo n'okukebera okw'oluddiŋŋana okuragula enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale ezikwatagana n'okugumira ebbugumu. Ebivaamu: Enkola yatuuka ku butuufu obw'okuragula obwa 78%, nga ewa obuzito obungi obuzaale obukola puloteyina eziziyiza obunnyogovu n'amakubo ag'enkola y'amasavu n'okuddamu ku kunyigirizibwa okwa oxidative. Ebiragulwa bikwatagana n'enkola ezimanyiddwa ez'okuwona okunnyogeza mu byewalula eby'ectothermic. Okumaliriza: Enkola esobozesa okusookera ebifo eby'obuzaale olw'okugumira obunnyogovu; okukakasa mu kugezesa n'okwongera ku bika kyetaagisa okukendeeza okwesigama okungi n'okulongoosa okutambuza wakati w'ebika.
experiment.exp-n9-predizione-effetti-edi: Okuragula ebivaamu ebitali ku kifo (off-target) eby'okukyusa obuzaale
Okukendeeza ebivaamu ebya off-target eby'okukyusa okwa CRISPR okuteekebwateekebwa mu bifo ebirala.
Okukola enkola mu silico ez'ebifo by'okusala n'neural networks ezaakakasibwa ku data z'okusoma obuzaale.
Okuragula kukendeeza okusala okwa off-target 30% mu nteekateeka ez'okugezesa ezaakebebwa.

Embeera: Okukendeeza ebivaamu ebya off-target kikulu olw'obukuumi bw'okukyusa okwa CRISPR-Cas9 okuteekebwateekebwa mu bifo ebirala. Enkola: Twakola enkola mu silico ez'okusala kwa sgRNA n'neural networks eziyigirizibwa ku data z'okusala ez'okugezesa okuyita mu genome yonna, nga tugatta okuragula obulungi bw'ekifo ekigenderere n'ekifaananyi ky'off-target mu nkola emu ey'okuteekateeka enkulembeze (guides). Ebivaamu: Mu nteekateeka ez'okugezesa ezaakebebwa, okulonda enkulembeze okukulembezebwa enkola kwakendeeza 30% okusala okwa off-target okusinga enkulembeze ezaalondebwa n'enkola eza bulijjo, nga bakuuma obulungi bw'ekifo ekigenderere. Ebifo bya off-target ebyaragulwa byakakasibwa n'okusoma obuzaale okulonda. Okumaliriza: Okugatta okuragula okwa off-target mu kuteekateeka enkulembeze kukendeeza obulabe bw'okukyusa okutayagalibwa; okukakasa mu kugezesa mu ngeri entegeke kikyetaagisa, kubanga ekitundu ky'ebifo bya off-target tekikwatibwa n'enkola z'okubalirira zokka.
experiment.exp-n9-atlante-espressione-mu: Okugatta data za RNA-seq ez'ebifo byonna mu tterekero limu ery'okwenkanya.
Enkola ya bioinformatics ey'okutereeza batch n'okugatta okutali kw'okulagirira (unsupervised clustering) wakati w'ebika.
Kwazuulibwa ebitundu by'okulaga ebikuumibwa eby'okuddaabiriza ebitundu wakati wa axolotl, enfudu n'enswaswa.

Embeera: Okugatta data za RNA-seq ezaakolebwa ebifo eby'enjawulo kiziyizibwa ebivaamu ebya batch eby'ekikugu n'eby'obulamu. Enkola: Twazimba enkola y'okutereeza etereeza ebivaamu ebya batch nga bazuula baliraanwa abasingako okumpi mu bwenkanya (mutual nearest neighbours) n'okuteeka mu kifo ekigabanibwa, oluvannyuma lw'okugatta okutali kw'okulagirira n'okugeraageranya ebitundu by'okulaga wakati w'ebika. Ebivaamu: Etterekero eryegattiddwa lyasobozesa okugatta obutoffaali okusinziira ku kika ky'obutoffaali okusinga ku tterekero we lyava. Kwazuulibwa ebitundu by'okulaga ebikuumibwa ebikwatagana n'okuddaabiriza ebitundu, ebigabanibwa wakati wa axolotl, enfudu n'enswaswa, ekiraga enkola y'obuzaale ey'okuzzaawo egatta. Okumaliriza: Etterekero ery'okwenkanya liwa ekigagga eky'okusoma okuzzaawo wakati w'ebika; okutegeera ebitundu ebikuumibwa kyetaagisa okukakasa okw'emirimu n'okufaayo ku bukoma bw'orthology wakati w'ebika ebiri ewala.
experiment.exp-n9-anomalie-neurali-emerg: Okuzuula obubonero bw'obwongo obutali bwa bulijjo
Okunoonya ebikwata ku buzaale ebitasuubirwa ebikwatagana n'enneeyisa z'amagezi ezitasuubirwa nteekateeka z'okwongera.
Okwekenneenya okugatta wakati w'enkyukakyuka n'enneeyisa ezaalagibwa ebifo, n'okufuga ebibalo okukalu.
Akabonero akanafu naye akaddiŋŋana ku makubo ag'enkula y'obwongo; okunnyonnyola kwakomebwa mu bugenderevu nga kulinda okuddibwamu.

Embeera: Okunoonya ebikwata ku buzaale ebitasuubirwa ebikwatagana n'enneeyisa z'amagezi ezitasuubirwa kyetaagisa okufuga ebibalo okukalu okwewala eby'obulimba. Enkola: Twakola okwekenneenya okugatta wakati w'enkyukakyuka z'obuzaale n'enneeyisa ezaalagibwa ebifo, nga tukozesa okupima ekitundu ky'obuzaale eky'enjawulo, okutereeza ensengeka y'ekibinja n'okutereeza olw'ebigezo ebingi. Ebivaamu: Kwavaayo akabonero akanafu naye akaddiŋŋana ku makubo ag'enkula y'obwongo; ekigero ky'ekivaamu kitono era obukulu buli ku kkomo ery'ebipimo ebitereeziddwa. Nga bwe kikwatagana n'obunafu obumanyiddwa obw'ebivaamu eby'amaanyi amatono ag'ebibalo, okunnyonnyola kwakomebwa mu bugenderevu. Okumaliriza: Akabonero kaka gwanaanya okuddibwamu mu ngeri ey'obwannannyini n'ebyokulabirako ebisingako obunene n'okupima enneeyisa mu ngeri ey'obulijjo nga tekunnaba kufuulwa nsonga; mu kiseera kino ebivaamu bibalibwa ng'okuzaala endowooza so si okumaliriza.
experiment.exp-n10-validazione-campo-pro: Okukakasa nti engeri ezongeddwa mu laabu zikuumibwa mu mbeera y'emirimu egy'amazima.
Ebigezo eby'obulijjo mu bifo ebifugibwa eby'ebweru n'okupima okuddiŋŋanako obusobozi obukulu.
Engeri ezisinga zigumira; obusobozi obumu bukendeera wansi w'okunyigirizibwa okw'obutonde okutasuubirwa.

Embeera: Engeri ezongeddwa mu laabu zisaanidde okukakasibwa mu mbeera y'emirimu egy'amazima okukakasa obunywevu bwazo. Enkola: Twakola ebigezo eby'obulijjo mu bifo ebifugibwa eby'ebweru, n'okupima okuddiŋŋanako obusobozi obukulu, enkola n'enteekateeka z'okwekenneenya ezaawandiikibwa nga tebinnaba kutandika n'amaanyi g'ebibalo agamala okukoma ebivaamu ebitaddibwamu. Ebivaamu: Engeri ezisinga zaakuumibwa mu bipimo ebyasuubirwa; kyokka obusobozi obumu bwakendeera wansi w'okunyigirizibwa okw'obutonde okutasuubirwa, ekiraga okwesigama ku mbeera okutakwatibwa embeera za laabu. Okumaliriza: Okukakasa oku ttale kukakasa obunywevu obw'awamu obw'enkola naye kuzuula ebintu eby'obutonde ebikulu ebiteekwa okugattibwa mu nkola z'okuragula; okuwandiika edda n'okuteeka ebipimo ku mutindo byakulembera obunywevu bw'ebivaamu.
experiment.exp-n10-sigma-integrazione-op: Programma Sigma: okugatta mu nkola okulabirirwa
Okuteekawo ensalo ez'enkozesa ey'obuvunaanyizibwa ez'ennyiriri ez'enkozesa ebbiri mu mbeera z'okukozesa ez'amazima.
Okusoma omusango n'okumenya obulabe, okwekenneenya kw'empisa okw'obwannannyini n'ebipimo by'okuyimiriza ebiteekebwawo.
Kwateekebwawo emitendera esatu egy'olukusa; ebiteeso bibiri byagaanibwa akakiiko olw'obulabe obutaakwatagana.

Embeera: Okukozesa ennyiriri ez'enkozesa ebbiri mu mbeera z'okukozesa ez'amazima kyetaagisa ensalo ez'enkozesa ey'obuvunaanyizibwa eziteekeddwawo edda. Enkola: Programma Sigma yakozesa okusoma omusango okutegeke n'okumenya obulabe, okwekenneenya kw'empisa okw'obwannannyini n'ebipimo by'okuyimiriza ebiteekebwawo, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola ez'ensi yonna ez'enfuga y'okunoonyereza okw'enkozesa ebbiri. Ebivaamu: Kwateekebwawo emitendera esatu egy'olukusa lw'okukozesa, egyategekebwa okusinziira ku bwenkanya bw'obulabe-n'omugaso n'obusoboka bw'okuddibwamu kw'enkyukakyuka. Akakiiko k'empisa kaagaana ebiteeso bibiri olw'obulabe obwalabika ng'obusukka omugaso ogusuubirwa. Okumaliriza: Enkola y'okusalawo ey'obulambulukufu, n'ebipimo n'ebiteekebwawo eby'okuyimiriza ebiraga, esobozesa okugatta mu nkola okulabirirwa okw'ennyiriri ez'enkozesa ebbiri; okwekenneenya okw'obwannannyini n'okuwandiika okusalwa okwagaanibwa bye bitundu ebikulu eby'obuvunaanyizibwa n'okusobola okugoberera.
experiment.exp-n10-riproducibilita-cross: Okukakasa oba ebivaamu by'ebifo ssekinnoomu biddibwamu n'enkola n'ebyuma eby'obwannannyini.
Okuddamu okukola okw'ekyama ebigezo ebyalondebwa n'ekibinja n'ebyuma ebitali by'oku nsibuko.
Kwaddibwamu 68% ku bigezo; ebitakwatagana biri ku bipimo by'enneeyisa ebeesigama ku ndowooza.

Embeera: Obwesige bw'ebivaamu by'ebifo ssekinnoomu bwesigamye ku busobozi bwabyo obw'okuddibwamu n'enkola n'ebyuma eby'obwannannyini. Enkola: Twalonda ekibinja ky'ebigezo ne tugezaako okubiddamu mu kyama, n'ekibinja, ebyuma ne reagents ebitali by'oku nsibuko, nga tuwandiika edda enkola n'okwekenneenya. Ebivaamu: Kwaddibwamu 68% ku bigezo ebyalondebwa. Ebitakwatagana byali ku bipimo by'enneeyisa ebeesigama ku ndowooza, so ng'ebipimo eby'obutoffaali n'eby'omubiri eby'amazima byalaga obunywevu obusingako. Ekigero ky'ekivaamu mu kuddibwamu kyali kitono okusinga eky'oku nsibuko. Okumaliriza: Ekigero ky'okuddibwamu kikwatagana n'ekyalabibwa mu pulojekiti ennene ez'okuddibwamu mu bujjanjabi; kirungi okuteeka ku mutindo ebipimo by'enneeyisa n'okukozesa mu ngeri entegeke okuwandiika edda okukendeeza enjawulo wakati w'ebifo.
experiment.exp-n10-quadro-etico-dual-use: Okuzimba enkola ey'obulambulukufu ey'okwekenneenya obulabe n'emigaso egy'ennyiriri ez'enkozesa ebbiri.
Enkola ya Delphi n'abakugu ab'omunda n'ab'ebweru n'okuteekawo ebipimo by'okukkiriza ebigabanibwa.
Yakkirizibwa ng'omutindo gw'ekkampuni; wakyaliyo obutakkiriziganya obuwandiike ku buzito bw'obulabe obwa wala.

Embeera: Okwekenneenya obulabe n'emigaso egy'ennyiriri ez'enkozesa ebbiri kyetaagisa enkola y'okusalawo ey'obulambulukufu era egabanibwa. Enkola: Twakozesa enkola ya Delphi n'abakugu ab'omunda n'ab'ebweru, nga tuddiŋŋana ebibuuzo n'okuddamu okufugibwa okutuusa nga twateekawo ebipimo by'okukkiriza ebigabanibwa n'enkola ez'obulambulukufu ez'okulaga okukkiriziganya. Ebivaamu: Enkola yavaamu enkola y'okusalawo eyakkirizibwa ng'omutindo gw'ekkampuni, n'ebipimo eby'amaddaala eby'okukkiriza n'obuvunaanyizibwa okuwandiika okusalawo. Wakyaliyo obutakkiriziganya obuwandiike ku buzito obw'okuwa obulabe obwa wala, obw'obusoboka obutono naye obw'ekivaamu ekinene. Okumaliriza: Enkola ya Delphi ewa ekkubo eritegeke era eriddibwamu olw'okukkiriziganya kw'abakugu ku kunoonyereza okw'enkozesa ebbiri, nga bwe kikwatagana n'enkola z'ensi yonna ez'enfuga; okuwandiika mu bulambulukufu obutakkiriziganya obusigaddewo kye kitundu eky'obuvunaanyizibwa mu kusalawo.
experiment.exp-n11-mimica-vocale-corvidi: Okusoma obusobozi bwa namuŋŋoona n'enkusu okwefaananyiriza n'okuzza amaloboozi amapya.
Okwolekera ebisikiriza by'amaloboozi ebifugibwa n'okwekenneenya okwa spectrographs okw'amaloboozi agakolebwa.
Okuzza obutuufu obwa phonemes ezizibu mu ssabbiiti ntono, n'okukwatibwa okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu.

Embeera. Ekifo N11 ekya Eden Exotic (ensi ya 47B) kyasoma obusobozi bwa namuŋŋoona n'enkusu, bombi abayigira amaloboozi mu ngeri ennene, okwefaananyiriza n'okuzza amaloboozi amapya. Enkola. Ensolo zaayolekerwa ebisikiriza by'amaloboozi ebifugibwa (phonemes ezikoleddwa n'amaloboozi ag'ebika ebirala) nga bwe kigobererwa entegeka eddiŋŋanako; ebyakolebwa byakwatibwa era byageraageranyizibwa n'ebifaananyi n'okwekenneenya okwa spectrographs, okupima okufaanana kwa spectrum n'ebiseera n'ebigezo by'okukwata oluvannyuma lwa ssabbiiti. Ebivaamu. Ebika byombi bizza obutuufu phonemes ezizibu mu ssabbiiti ntono, n'okulongoosa okugenda mu maaso kw'okufaanana n'okunywereza template eyayigibwa; okukwata okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu kwa waggulu ne bwe wataba kuwagira kw'olubeerera. Okukyukakyuka kw'eddoboozi kukwatagana n'omuguddo gw'okuyiga eddoboozi ogugatta ennyonyi eziyimba, enkusu n'omuntu. Okumaliriza. Namuŋŋoona n'enkusu ez'ekifo N11 zalaga okuyiga eddoboozi mu ngeri ennene n'okujjukira amaloboozi okunywevu, ebyetaagisa olw'ebigezo eby'oluvannyuma ku bubonero obw'obwesimbu, okuyita ku bintu n'okuwaayo obuwangwa bw'amaloboozi.
experiment.exp-n11-firma-vocale-identita: Okukakasa oba ennyonyi zikozesa amaloboozi ag'enjawulo ng'obubonero okuzuula ensolo ssekinnoomu.
Okuwandiika n'okwawula okwa yeekya (automatic) amaloboozi n'enkola z'amaloboozi n'ebigezo bya playback.
Kwazuulibwa amaloboozi-amannya amanywevu; ensolo ziddamu mu ngeri elonda eri akabonero kaazo.

Embeera. Ekifo N11 kyakakasa oba ennyonyi zikozesa amaloboozi ag'enjawulo ng'obubonero obw'amaloboozi okuzuula ensolo ssekinnoomu. Enkola. Amaloboozi ag'okukwatagana ag'ekibinja ekiriko obubonero gaawandiikibwa era gaayawulwa n'enkola z'amaloboozi eza yeekya; ebigezo bya playback byapima okuddamu okulonda kw'ensolo eri akabonero kaazo n'ak'ensolo ezimanyiddwa n'ezitali zimanyiddwa, nga bapima ekiseera, okwolekera n'okuddamu okw'eddoboozi. Ebivaamu. Kwazuulibwa obubonero bw'amaloboozi obw'omuntu obunywevu, obwayigibwa mu nkula; ensolo ziddamu mu ngeri elonda eri akabonero kaazo era zilaga okukwatagana kw'amaloboozi mu nkolagana, nga zeefaananyiriza akaloboozi k'ensolo gye zoogeramu. Okukozesa obubonero bw'amaloboozi obwayigibwa okwogera n'ensolo ssekinnoomu kufaanana n'ebyalabibwa mu nkusu ez'omu nsiko ne mu dolphins. Okumaliriza. Ennyonyi ez'ekifo N11 zirina enkola y'obwesimbu bw'eddoboozi esinziira ku bubonero obwayigibwa era obugabanibwa, obukola ng'erinnya ery'omuntu ssekinnoomu mu mukutu gw'obwenkanya; ekivaamu kissa omusingi gw'ebigezo eby'okuwuliziganya okukwata ku bintu ebiddirira.
experiment.exp-n11-comunicazione-referen: Okukakasa oba amaloboozi gasobola okukwata ku bintu oba ebibaawo eby'enjawulo eby'embeera.
Emirimu gy'okuwaanyisiganya n'okusaba ebintu n'okugatta okwayigibwa wakati w'eddoboozi n'ekyoyogerako.
Ensolo ezimu zisaba ekintu ekituufu n'amaloboozi agenkanidde; obunywevu bukyali mu kukebebwa.

Embeera. Ekifo N11 kyekenneenya oba amaloboozi gasobola okukwata ku bintu oba ebibaawo eby'enjawulo eby'embeera, kwe kugamba oba gawagira okuwuliziganya okukwata ku bintu. Enkola. Mu mirimu gy'okuwaanyisiganya n'okusaba ebintu, ensolo zaayiga okugatta wakati w'amaloboozi agenkanidde n'ebyoyogerako; kwapimibwa obutuufu bw'okusaba ekintu ekituufu, okugaziya ku bintu ebipya n'obunywevu mu ntereka ez'obutefeere, nga bafuga okuyiga okw'okugatta okutali kukwata ku kintu. Ebivaamu. Ensolo ezimu zisaba ekintu ekituufu nga zifulumya amaloboozi agenkanidde era zigaziya ku bintu ebipya, ekiraga okukozesa akabonero mu ngeri ekwata ku kintu, ekifaanana n'okukozesa obubonero obw'amaloboozi okwawandiikibwa mu nkusu enzirugavu n'okuwuliziganya kw'obubonero bw'okulabula. Obunywevu bukyakyukakyuka wakati w'ensolo era bukyali mu kukebebwa kw'ebibalo. Okumaliriza. Amaloboozi g'ennyonyi ez'ekifo N11 gasobola okukwata ku bintu eby'ebweru okusukka ku mbeera y'omutima gw'oyo awa akabonero, wadde nga okukwata ku bintu okutuukiridde kwetaaga okukebera okulala; ebivaamu biteeka ebika bino mu nkola y'okuwuliziganya okukwata ku bintu mu nsolo.
experiment.exp-n11-cultura-vocale-trasmi: Okwetegereza engeri amaloboozi gye gasaasaana era gye gakyuka mu bibinja ku biseera.
Okulondoola amaloboozi okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu okw'ebibinja n'okwekenneenya emikutu gy'okufaanana kw'amaloboozi.
Kwawandiikibwa okusaasaana kw'amaloboozi ag'enjawulo wakati w'ensolo, n'enkyukakyuka ezifaanana ne dialects ez'ekitundu.

Embeera. Ekifo N11 kyetegereza engeri amaloboozi gye gasaasaana era gye gakyuka mu bibinja ku biseera, nga banoonya obukakafu bw'okuwaayo obuwangwa n'okukola dialects. Enkola. Okulondoola amaloboozi okw'ekiseera ekiwanvu okw'ebibinja ebinywevu kwakuŋŋaanya amaloboozi enkumi n'enkumi; emikutu gy'okufaanana kw'amaloboozi wakati w'ensolo ne ku biseera gyazzibwamu n'okwawula okwa yeekya, nga bagoberera okuvaayo n'okusaasaana kw'amaloboozi ag'enjawulo n'okukyuka kwago. Ebivaamu. Kwawandiikibwa okusaasaana kw'amaloboozi ag'enjawulo wakati w'ensolo ezikwatagana mu bwenkanya, n'okukwatagana munda mu bibinja ebitono n'okwawukana wakati w'ebibinja ebyawuddwa, ekivaamu enkyukakyuka ezifaanana ne dialects ez'ekitundu. Okuwaayo kugoberera amakubo ag'obwenkanya okusinga ag'obuzaale, nga bwe kikwatagana n'okuyiga eddoboozi okw'obuwangwa okunnyonnyoddwa mu nnyonyi eziyimba n'enkusu ez'omu nsiko. Okumaliriza. Amaloboozi g'ekifo N11 nnono eziyigibwa, ezikyukakyuka era ezitegekeddwa mu bwenkanya; okuvaayo kwa dialects kuwa ekyokulabirako eky'okugezesa olw'okusoma okukyukakyuka kw'obuwangwa okw'okuwuliziganya era kikwataganya okuddukanya ebibinja mu buggya.

Genomics ey'obutuufu, obulunzi obufugibwa n'okusoma enneeyisa olw'ensolo ezisinga okugumira, ezisinga okunywera n'ezisinga okukula amangu. Buli ngeri eyongeddwako yongera engeri ekyaliwo mu butonde: tetuyiiya, tuyanguya.

company.principi: Omutindo gumu, embeera z'emirimu essatu: obunnyogovu, ebbugumu ery'ekigero, n'ery'ekitalo.

mission.statement: Okuzimba enkola z'obulamu ezeetereeza era ezigumu — ezisobola okukula awo obulamu obwa bulijjo we bunaanyizibwa — ng'oyita mu buyinjiniya bw'obuzaale obukalu, obupimibwa era obw'obuvunaanyizibwa.
mission.visione: Ebiseera eby'omu maaso obulamu obugumu we buyinza okutegekebwa: olw'okukuuma ebika, olw'ebifo ebizibu, olw'okunoonyereza n'olw'okwerinda kw'abantu.
mission.dualUse: Ekitundu ky'okunoonyereza kwaffe kirina enkozesa ebbiri (ez'obuntu n'ez'okwerinda). Tukikwata n'obwesimbu: ebigendererwa ebilangiddwa, okulabirira okw'enjawulo n'enzikiriza nti tekinologiya si nnungi oba mbi mu yo yennyini, wabula olw'engeri gy'ekozesebwa.

mission.valori.testo: Ekiteeso, enkola, ekipimo. Tewali kigambo awatali data.
Ebigendererwa ebinene, entambula ekebereka. Emirembe gy'ekipimo kyaffe eky'enkulaakulana.
Enkozesa ebbiri ekwatibwa nga bw'eri: ebigendererwa ebituufu, okulondoola okukalu, okusobola okugoberera okutuukiridde.
Ensolo za bantu ba kusomebwa, si nkola bwereere. Obulamu n'ekitiibwa biwandiikibwa.
Ekitali kyetegefu tekirangirirwa. Obuteesa bukuuma okunoonyereza n'abo abakikola.

sigma.descrizione: Olunyiriri lw'okunoonyereza olw'enkola z'obulamu ezeetereeza era ezigumu ezigenderere ebifo ebizibu, obuyambi n'okwerinda kw'abantu. Lulimu okukakasa oku ttale kw'ensolo n'okuzigatta mu nkola. Ebigendererwa ebituufu, okulabirira okw'enjawulo, okuyingira okukomeddwa.
conformita.testo: Buli nsolo elondoolebwa nga bwe kigobererwa Endagaano ya Washington (CITES, 1973), Etteeka (EC) N. 338/97 n'Etteeka 150/1992. Ebiwandiiko eby'okusobola okugoberera bigenda n'ensolo mu buli kutambuzibwa. Obujjuvu bw'ennyiriri kye kisookera ddala ku buli mulimu.
